Ahri.build: In the early game, hold out with a Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots. Ahri deals mostly magic damage, so build magic resistance first, but resistance cannot reduce the true damage from the return of Ahri Q Orb of Deception. Consider Morellonomicon if the healing from Ahri P Essence Theft becomes a problem.
Ahri.combo: After dodging Ahri E Charm, slow her with Karma Q Inner Flame, then catch her with Karma W Focused Resolve and maintain the tether. When your allies follow up, give them movement speed and a shield with Karma E Inspire, then layer Karma Q Inner Flame empowered by Karma R Mantra on the rooted target. If it's difficult to start with Q, cast Karma E Inspire on yourself to get into W range.
Ahri.escape: The moment after Ahri E Charm misses is an opportunity to engage.
Ahri.fight: When Karma Q Inner Flame isn't blocked by minions, hit Ahri to slow her, then maintain Karma W Focused Resolve's tether to root her. The moment after dodging Ahri E Charm is an opportunity to close in, and it's even better if Ahri R Spirit Rush is also down. Use the shield and movement speed from Karma E Inspire before taking damage or just before closing in.
Ahri.laning: Keep a line of minions between you and Ahri to avoid Ahri E Charm, and only look to hit her with Karma Q Inner Flame when she steps out from behind the minion wall. Karma Q Inner Flame and E Inspire cost a lot of mana, so don't use them for poke when you have no clear shot or for unnecessary waveclear.
Ahri.phase: The available information isn't enough to determine who has the advantage in the mid game, so fight when Ahri E Charm and R Spirit Rush are down. In the late game, Karma's single-target burst falls off, so support your allies with area shields and movement speed.
Ahri.teamfight: Look for a chance to catch Ahri right after dodging Ahri E Charm, while using Karma E Inspire to protect your allies and help them move. Then hit enemy champions with Karma's basic abilities to use P Gathering Fire and bring up your next R Mantra sooner.
Ahri.watch: Stay behind minions to avoid Ahri E Charm, since getting hit can leave you open to her full follow-up combo. Ahri Q Orb of Deception deals true damage on its return, so after dodging the first pass, move out of its return path as well. If Ahri R Spirit Rush is available, she can use a dash to create distance.

Akali.build: In the early game, hold out with a Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots. Akali deals mostly magic damage, and Karma has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Akali's high magic resistance blocks Karma's magic damage well, so include penetration when increasing your damage.
Akali.combo: Slow Akali with Karma Q Inner Flame, then catch and root her with Karma W Focused Resolve. When your allies engage with you, help them get in with Karma E Inspire.
Akali.escape: Dodging Akali E Shuriken Flip creates an opening to engage, but be careful about chasing if Akali W Twilight Shroud or Akali R Perfect Execution is still available. In particular, before Akali R Perfect Execution comes off cooldown, catch her with Karma W Focused Resolve and Karma R Mantra while her other mobility tools are also down.
Akali.fight: Slow Akali with Karma Q Inner Flame, then maintain Karma W Focused Resolve's tether to root her. If Akali gets on top of you, also use the healing from Karma W Focused Resolve empowered by Karma R Mantra.
Akali.laning: Karma Q Inner Flame is blocked by minions, so hit Akali when she steps out from behind them, and don't waste mana by throwing it out recklessly. Trade back when Akali comes out of Akali W Twilight Shroud to attack.
Akali.phase: In the mid game, choose when to fight based on whether Akali R Perfect Execution has been used. In the late game, focus less on Karma's single-target burst and more on providing area shields and movement speed.
Akali.teamfight: If Akali engages on an ally, catch her with Karma W Focused Resolve and help your ally disengage with Karma E Inspire. Then hit enemy champions with basic abilities to use Karma P Gathering Fire and bring up your next Karma R Mantra sooner.
Akali.watch: If you are hit and marked, the second dash will follow you even if you try to escape.

Akshan.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Akshan Q Avengerang, Akshan E Heroic Swing, and Akshan R Comeuppance. Akshan P Dirty Fighting includes both damage types, so armor alone won't block all of his damage. He also relies heavily on basic attacks, so reducing his attack speed is effective.
Akshan.combo: When Akshan E Heroic Swing is down, slow him with Karma Q Inner Flame, then maintain Karma W Focused Resolve's tether to root him. If it's hard to get close, cast Karma E Inspire on yourself to get into Karma W Focused Resolve range. After catching Akshan, layer Karma Q Inner Flame empowered by Karma R Mantra to hit him with the delayed explosion as well.
Akshan.escape: The moment after Akshan E Heroic Swing is down is Karma's window to engage. Use Karma E Inspire's movement speed to approach, then bind Akshan with Karma W Focused Resolve and, if needed, empower the root with Karma R Mantra. Akshan E Heroic Swing's cooldown resets when he gets a takedown, so engage carefully in fights where that could happen.
Akshan.fight: Right after you get Akshan to use Akshan E Heroic Swing, close the gap with Karma E Inspire and look to root him with Karma W Focused Resolve. Account for the shield and movement speed from Akshan P Dirty Fighting by using a slow or your own movement speed boost before starting with Karma W Focused Resolve alone.
Akshan.laning: Karma Q Inner Flame is blocked by minions, so use it when Akshan steps out from behind the minion wall, and save it when you have no clear shot so you don't run out of mana. Akshan Q Avengerang gains range through minions, so don't assume standing behind the wave is enough to dodge it.
Akshan.phase: In the mid game, look for moments when Akshan E Heroic Swing is down, and keep vision around the river and jungle walls to prepare for Akshan’s camouflaged roams with Akshan W Going Rogue. In the late game, Karma should focus less on single-target burst and more on the area shield and movement speed from Karma E Inspire and Karma R Mantra.
Akshan.teamfight: If Akshan engages with Akshan E Heroic Swing, catch him with Karma W Focused Resolve. When your allies take damage, protect them as well with Karma E Inspire empowered by Karma R Mantra. Hit enemy champions with basic abilities to use Karma P Gathering Fire and bring up your next Karma R Mantra sooner. If you have the villain mark, don't face Akshan alone, and fight outside his range so he can't finish you off.
Akshan.watch: Akshan Q Avengerang gains range when it hits minions, and its return path is also dangerous, so watch its full path instead of trying to dodge by standing behind the wave. Akshan E Heroic Swing uses walls to engage and resets its cooldown when he gets a takedown, so watch for engage angles near walls. If you're low and targeted by Akshan R Comeuppance, use Karma E Inspire's movement speed to get behind terrain or stand behind an ally.

Alistar.build: In the early game, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots. Alistar's main damage is magic, and Karma has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. If Alistar's crowd control catches your allied carry, prioritize Mikael's Blessing.
Alistar.combo: When trading back, slow Alistar with Karma Q Inner Flame, then maintain Karma W Focused Resolve's tether to root him. When your allies go in to attack, give them a shield and movement speed with Karma E Inspire.
Alistar.escape: The moment after Alistar W Headbutt is down is an opportunity to close the gap or pick him off. If Alistar Q Pulverize is also down, slow him with Karma Q Inner Flame and catch him with Karma W Focused Resolve during that window.
Alistar.fight: Close the gap and trade back right after Alistar W Headbutt and Alistar Q Pulverize are down. When Alistar steps out from behind the minion wall, slow him with Karma Q Inner Flame, then follow with Karma W Focused Resolve to root him when you can catch him. If Alistar R Unbreakable Will is active, back off and wait out its duration before fighting again.
Alistar.laning: As a rule, when Alistar engages, catch him with Karma W Focused Resolve and help your allied marksman disengage with Karma E Inspire. Use Karma Q Inner Flame when you have a clear shot at an enemy champion to manage both your mana and your R Mantra cooldown.
Alistar.phase: In the mid game, keep looking to poke or reposition when Alistar W Headbutt and Alistar Q Pulverize are down. In the late game, focus less on Karma's single-target burst and more on the area shield and movement speed from Karma E Inspire empowered by Karma R Mantra.
Alistar.teamfight: When Alistar R Unbreakable Will is active, don't pour damage into him; back off and fight again afterward. If you can't retreat, interrupt his engage by applying a fresh root with Karma W Focused Resolve after he activates his ultimate. If several allies take damage, use Karma E Inspire empowered by Karma R Mantra, then hit enemy champions with basic abilities to bring up your next R Mantra sooner.
Alistar.watch: Watch for Alistar's combo of closing the gap with Alistar W Headbutt, knocking you up with Alistar Q Pulverize, and stunning you with Alistar E Trample. Karma has no ability to escape on her own, so keep your distance outside Alistar W Headbutt's range. Near a turret, don't give Alistar room to circle behind you and use Alistar W Headbutt to knock you under it.

Ambessa.build: Ambessa's main damage is physical, so prioritize armor. Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep / Sundering Slam deals damage based on maximum health, so avoid choices that add a lot of health alone. If Ambessa's engage can leave your allied carry immobilized, prioritize Mikael's Blessing; consider Morellonomicon if her healing becomes a problem.
Ambessa.combo: After Ambessa has spent her abilities and charges, slow her with Karma Q Inner Flame, then follow with Karma W Focused Resolve and maintain the tether to root her. When your allies go in with you, give them a shield and movement speed with Karma E Inspire. After catching Ambessa, layer Karma Q Inner Flame empowered by Karma R Mantra to also hit her with the area damage.
Ambessa.escape: The moment after Ambessa has used all her abilities and spent the charges of Ambessa P Drakehound's Step is Karma's opportunity to engage. If the slow from Ambessa E Lacerate is still active, first use Karma E Inspire to manage the distance. Don't attack during the windup for Ambessa W Repudiation either; after leaving its range, engage with Karma Q Inner Flame and Karma W Focused Resolve.
Ambessa.fight: Ambessa can close the gap each time she casts an ability with Ambessa P Drakehound's Step, so trade back right after she has used her abilities and charges. Stop attacking and leave the area during the windup for Ambessa W Repudiation. When trading back, slow her with Karma Q Inner Flame, then maintain Karma W Focused Resolve's tether to look for a root.
Ambessa.laning: Use Karma Q Inner Flame when Ambessa steps out from behind the minion wall and you have a clear shot at an enemy champion; don't waste mana by using it recklessly. If Ambessa engages on an ally, catch her with Karma W Focused Resolve and cast Karma E Inspire on your ally to help them get out.
Ambessa.phase: Ambessa gets stronger in the mid game as she builds core items, so keep up in levels without giving up early kills. In the late game, support your allies with the area shield and movement speed from Karma E Inspire empowered by Karma R Mantra, rather than focusing on single-target damage.
Ambessa.teamfight: Position so there isn't a straight line for Ambessa R Public Execution to reach your team's backline during standoffs. If Ambessa goes in, catch her with Karma W Focused Resolve and help your allies disengage with Karma E Inspire. When several allies take damage, use Karma E Inspire empowered by Karma R Mantra, then hit enemy champions with basic abilities to bring up your next Karma R Mantra sooner.
Ambessa.watch: When you see the windup for Ambessa W Repudiation, stop attacking and move out of its range. If you dodge the first hit of Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep / Sundering Slam, the second hit won't happen; if it's hard to dodge, standing closer to Ambessa's body hurts less than being near the blade's edge. If Ambessa E Lacerate hits you, don't wait for the slow to wear off—use Karma E Inspire's movement speed to get away immediately. Ambessa R Public Execution targets the farthest champion in a straight line, so don't line up with your team's backline.

Anivia.build: In the early game, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots. Anivia's main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first.
Anivia.combo: After Anivia Q Flash Frost is down, slow her with Karma Q Inner Flame, then maintain Karma W Focused Resolve's tether to root her. If the distance is awkward, cast Karma E Inspire on yourself for movement speed, then use Karma W Focused Resolve. Layer Karma Q Inner Flame empowered by Karma R Mantra on the rooted target to also hit her with the area effect.
Anivia.escape: Anivia has no mobility ability, so close the gap while Anivia Q Flash Frost is down. Avoid narrow paths where Anivia W Crystallize could separate you from your allies, and approach in open areas with Karma E Inspire's movement speed while maintaining Karma W Focused Resolve's tether.
Anivia.fight: Poke Anivia with Karma Q Inner Flame when it can reach her without being blocked by minions, and use the hit to cycle Karma R Mantra again. If Anivia Q Flash Frost is down, close the gap with Karma E Inspire and maintain Karma W Focused Resolve's tether to root her. If Anivia P Rebirth is available, go in with allies who can break the egg.
Anivia.laning: Use Karma Q Inner Flame when you have a clear shot at Anivia, and don't waste mana on clearing minions.
Anivia.phase: In the mid game, fight in open areas to avoid situations where Anivia W Crystallize blocks a narrow path. In the late game, help your allies with the area shield and movement speed from Karma E Inspire empowered by Karma R Mantra, rather than focusing on single-target burst.
Anivia.teamfight: Start fights in open areas instead of jungle corridors, where Anivia W Crystallize can easily block your escape. If an ally is caught, bind the opponent with Karma W Focused Resolve and help your ally get out with Karma E Inspire.
Anivia.watch: Anivia Q Flash Frost can detonate while traveling and stun you, so keep your distance outside its range. After getting hit, immediately leave Anivia R Glacial Storm so you don't take the empowered damage from Anivia E Frostbite. Avoid fighting in narrow paths where Anivia W Crystallize can block your escape route.

Annie.build: In the early game, hold out with a Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots. Annie deals magic damage, so build magic resistance first. Prioritize Mikael's Blessing if Annie's stun catches your allied carry.
Annie.combo: When Annie uses her stun and steps forward, slow her with Karma Q Inner Flame, then root her with Karma W Focused Resolve. Help your allies follow up with Karma E Inspire's movement speed.
Annie.escape: Go in after Annie P Pyromania's stun is down, while Annie is building her stacks again. Annie has no ability to create distance on her own, so approach with the slow from Karma Q Inner Flame or the movement speed from Karma E Inspire, then maintain Karma W Focused Resolve's tether.
Annie.fight: After Annie has used her stun, poke with Karma Q Inner Flame and land it to cycle Karma R Mantra again. When Annie steps forward, slow her with Karma Q Inner Flame, then maintain Karma W Focused Resolve's tether to root her. If it's hard to get close, cast Karma E Inspire on yourself for movement speed.
Annie.laning: Keep your distance while Annie's stun is ready, and pressure her after she uses it. Karma Q Inner Flame is blocked by minions, so use it when Annie steps out from behind the minion wall, and save mana when you have no clear shot. If Annie engages, catch the opponent who comes in with Karma W Focused Resolve and help your allied marksman disengage with Karma E Inspire.
Annie.phase: In the mid game, continue to base your pokes and engages on whether Annie's stun is ready. In the late game, focus less on Karma's single-target burst and more on the area shield and movement speed from Karma E Inspire empowered by Karma R Mantra.
Annie.teamfight: If Annie is out of sight or has her stun ready, don't stand clumped with your allies, and decide who will be ready to catch her if she steps forward. If you need to stop Annie's engage, use Karma W Focused Resolve empowered by Karma R Mantra; if you need to absorb area damage, protect your allies with empowered Karma E Inspire. Then hit enemy champions with basic abilities to bring up your next Karma R Mantra sooner.
Annie.watch: When white light swirls around Annie, Annie P Pyromania's stun is ready, so stay outside her ability range. Avoid standing clumped when Annie is out of sight or has her stun ready so several people don't get hit by the area stun from Annie R Summon: Tibbers. After Tibbers is summoned, don't stay in that area, even if you have killed Annie.

Ashe.build: If you need to prepare for an engage where Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow stuns an allied carry, buy Mikael’s Blessing early. Karma E Inspire’s shield can block damage, but it cannot remove a stun.
Ashe.combo: When Ashe W Volley is down, slow her with Karma Q Inner Flame and keep Karma W Focused Resolve tethered to root her. While your allies attack, help them engage with Karma E Inspire.
Ashe.escape: Engage during the window when Ashe W Volley is down and Ashe Q Ranger’s Focus has ended. If you can reach Ashe, use the slow from Karma Q Inner Flame or the movement speed from Karma E Inspire to keep Karma W Focused Resolve tethered. If Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow is available, don’t start a fight from out of vision.
Ashe.fight: Trade after Ashe W Volley is down and Ashe Q Ranger’s Focus has ended. When Ashe steps outside the minion line, slow her with Karma Q Inner Flame and close in using the movement speed from Karma E Inspire. Keep your distance while Ashe Q Ranger’s Focus is active.
Ashe.laning: Karma Q Inner Flame is blocked by minions, so use it when you have a clear angle to hit Ashe, and don’t waste mana by throwing it recklessly. If the enemy support engages first, catch the engaging champion with Karma W Focused Resolve and use Karma E Inspire to pull your allied marksman out.
Ashe.phase: In the mid game, use Karma E Inspire or the movement speed from an empowered shield to move and rotate with your allies. In the late game, focus more on team-wide shields and movement speed than Karma’s single-target burst.
Ashe.teamfight: Against engages started by Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow, catch the opponent who comes in with Karma W Focused Resolve and use Karma E Inspire to protect allies or pull them out. When area damage is coming, use Karma E Inspire empowered by Karma R Mantra on nearby allies. Then hit enemy champions with basic abilities to trigger Karma P Gathering Fire and bring Karma R Mantra up sooner.
Ashe.watch: Ashe W Volley applies an area slow, so sidestep it. Ashe P Frost Shot’s slow refreshes with every basic attack, so don’t stay in Ashe’s attack range for long. While Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow is available, don’t start a small skirmish from out of vision, and change direction to dodge if the arrow comes your way.

AurelionSol.build: Aurelion Sol's main damage is magic, so hold out with a Null-Magic Mantle early and build magic resistance first. Choose Mercury's Treads for your boots. Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light deals damage based on maximum health, so avoid choices that add a lot of health alone.
AurelionSol.combo: After Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight is down, slow him with Karma Q Inner Flame, then close in with Karma W Focused Resolve and maintain its tether to root him. If your allies go in with you, help them engage with Karma E Inspire.
AurelionSol.escape: The moment after you get Aurelion Sol to use Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight is Karma's opportunity to close the gap. After avoiding the risk of being caught by Aurelion Sol E Singularity or Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend, use Karma E Inspire's movement speed to get into range for Karma W Focused Resolve.
AurelionSol.fight: Before Aurelion Sol builds up Stardust in the early game, poke by hitting an enemy champion with Karma Q Inner Flame, then use Karma P Gathering Fire to cycle R Mantra. If Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight is down, slow him with Karma Q Inner Flame, then maintain Karma W Focused Resolve's tether to look for a root. Karma has no ability to escape on her own, so first keep enough distance to avoid the opponent's catch abilities.
AurelionSol.laning: Karma Q Inner Flame is blocked by minions, so hit Aurelion Sol with it when he steps out from behind the minion wall, and don't spend mana on pointless waveclear. Don't take Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light to the face while poking; back out of its range to reduce his chances to build Stardust.
AurelionSol.phase: In the mid game, avoid taking unnecessary ability hits, since Aurelion Sol becomes harder to catch with the same engage angle as he builds Stardust. In the late game, focus less on Karma's single-target burst and more on the area shield and movement speed from Karma E Inspire empowered by Karma R Mantra.
AurelionSol.teamfight: If Aurelion Sol engages with Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight, catch him with Karma W Focused Resolve to prevent him from re-engaging after participating in a takedown. Don't bunch up in narrow corridors, so several people don't get hit by the empowered Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend. When area damage comes in, give your allies a shield and movement speed with Karma E Inspire empowered by Karma R Mantra, then hit with basic abilities to bring up your next R Mantra sooner.
AurelionSol.watch: Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light deals damage based on maximum health, and holding it on you for a long time adds extra damage and Stardust. Stand behind minions when trading poke and quickly move out of his line of aim. When low on health, avoid the center of Aurelion Sol E Singularity, and in the late game, spread out so several people don't get hit by the empowered Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend.

Aurora.build: Aurora’s main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. Buy a Null-Magic Mantle early and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Consider Morellonomicon if the healing from Aurora P Spirit Abjuration becomes a problem.
Aurora.combo: If Aurora is visible and you can hit her with Karma Q Inner Flame, slow her, then keep Karma W Focused Resolve tethered to root her. Layer Karma Q Inner Flame empowered by Karma R Mantra over the rooted spot to aim for the area damage too. If you lack the range to get close, cast Karma E Inspire on yourself for movement speed, then approach with Karma W Focused Resolve.
Aurora.escape: Don’t engage just because Aurora W Across the Veil is down. Aurora E The Weirding and Aurora R Between Worlds are also ways for her to move, so look to root her with Karma W Focused Resolve, especially before Aurora R Between Worlds comes off cooldown. If Aurora is stealthed, wait until she is visible again before landing your abilities.
Aurora.fight: Avoid trading while low on health within range of Aurora Q Twofold Hex. If Aurora uses her mobility spell to engage and fails to secure a takedown, slow her with Karma Q Inner Flame and keep Karma W Focused Resolve tethered to aim for a root. Use Karma E Inspire just before moving in or just before retreating to benefit from both the shield and movement speed.
Aurora.laning: Karma Q Inner Flame is blocked by minions, so use it when Aurora steps outside the minion line and you have a clear angle. Don’t waste Karma Q Inner Flame on clearing minions, or you may run out of mana.
Aurora.phase: In the mid game, use Karma E Inspire or empowered Karma E Inspire to move with your allies and help with roams and objective rotations. In the late game, focus more on team-wide shields and movement speed than single-target damage.
Aurora.teamfight: When Aurora engages, catch her with Karma W Focused Resolve. When your team needs to absorb area damage, use empowered Karma E Inspire to shield allies and give them movement speed. If Aurora gets a takedown, her leap ability’s cooldown resets, so don’t leave low-health allies behind when retreating. Keep hitting basic abilities to prepare Karma R Mantra again.
Aurora.watch: If Aurora Q Twofold Hex hits you, it damages you again when it returns, and that damage increases based on your missing health. If you are cursed, move out of the line connecting you to Aurora, and if your health is low, retreat before it returns. After Aurora R Between Worlds unfolds, you are slowed when leaving it, so decide whether to leave before the zone appears.

Azir.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle early and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Azir’s main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first.
Azir.combo: Slow Azir with Karma Q Inner Flame, then keep Karma W Focused Resolve tethered to root him. If the root lands, layer Karma Q Inner Flame empowered by Karma R Mantra over him to aim for the area damage too. If your allies are engaging with you, use Karma E Inspire to give them a shield and movement speed.
Azir.escape: The moment Azir uses Azir E Shifting Sands is your chance to engage. Close the distance with Karma E Inspire and catch him with Karma W Focused Resolve, then press your attack before he can escape again. The risk of being pushed back is also lower if Azir R Emperor’s Divide is down.
Azir.fight: Circle around to target Azir when the soldiers moved by Azir Q Conquering Sands have stopped or their duration has ended. Slow him with Karma Q Inner Flame, then keep Karma W Focused Resolve tethered while taking a short trade. If it’s hard to get close, cast Karma E Inspire on yourself for movement speed.
Azir.laning: Karma Q Inner Flame is blocked by minions, so hit Azir when he steps outside the minion line, and don’t use it for reckless poke if you want to conserve mana. Close the distance when Azir’s soldiers disappear or he is low on mana.
Azir.phase: In the mid game, take short fights when Azir’s soldiers or Azir E Shifting Sands are down to slow his growth. Azir gets stronger as the game goes on, so in the late game Karma should help allies with shields and movement speed rather than single-target burst.
Azir.teamfight: Engage from multiple directions in open areas so Azir R Emperor’s Divide doesn’t push several of you back at once. If you need to stop Azir from engaging, use Karma W Focused Resolve empowered by Karma R Mantra; if your team needs to absorb area damage, use empowered Karma E Inspire. Then hit enemy champions with basic abilities to trigger Karma P Gathering Fire and bring Karma R Mantra back sooner.
Azir.watch: Standing in front of soldiers raised by Azir W Arise! for too long means taking repeated damage, so move beside or behind them. Azir Q Conquering Sands can move his soldiers and slow you, so approach after they stop. Avoid engaging in narrow passages, where Azir R Emperor’s Divide can push back several players and the soldier wall can block follow-up engages.

Bard.build: Survive early with a Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Bard’s main damage is magic, so build magic resistance. If stuns from Bard Q Cosmic Binding trapping an allied carry are a problem, buy Mikael’s Blessing early.
Bard.combo: When Bard steps outside the minion line, slow him with Karma Q Inner Flame and keep Karma W Focused Resolve tethered to root him, then help your allies engage with Karma E Inspire.
Bard.escape: The moment Bard E Magical Journey is down is your window to close the distance or pick Bard off. Position yourself to avoid the stun from Bard Q Cosmic Binding, approach with Karma E Inspire, and aim to root him with Karma W Focused Resolve.
Bard.fight: Karma Q Inner Flame is blocked by minions, so hit Bard with it to slow him when he steps outside the minion line. After making Bard use Bard E Magical Journey, close the distance with the movement speed from Karma E Inspire and follow up with Karma W Focused Resolve.
Bard.laning: Walk over Bard W Caretaker’s Shrine placed in lane to remove it, and when Bard engages, catch him with Karma W Focused Resolve while using Karma E Inspire to pull your allied marksman out.
Bard.phase: In the late game, support your allies with the team-wide shield and movement speed from Karma E Inspire empowered by Karma R Mantra, rather than single-target burst.
Bard.teamfight: Then keep hitting enemy champions with basic abilities to trigger Karma P Gathering Fire and bring Karma R Mantra up sooner.
Bard.watch: Bard Q Cosmic Binding stuns if it hits a wall or a second target, so don’t stand with a wall behind you or in a line with an ally or minion. Watch for Bard E Magical Journey angles from the side, and don’t commit your attacks before the damage immunity from Bard R Tempered Fate ends.

Blitzcrank.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle early and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Blitzcrank’s main damage, Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab and Blitzcrank R Static Field, is magic, so build magic resistance first.
Blitzcrank.combo: After Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab is down, slow him with Karma Q Inner Flame and root him with Karma W Focused Resolve. If you need to turn around a situation where you’ve been caught, use the healing and longer root from Karma W Focused Resolve empowered by Karma R Mantra.
Blitzcrank.escape: The moment Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab misses is your chance to engage. Blitzcrank has no ability to create distance on his own, so slow him with Karma Q Inner Flame and keep Karma W Focused Resolve tethered. Also look for an opening when Blitzcrank is too low on mana to use his grab.
Blitzcrank.fight: Trade with Karma Q Inner Flame right after Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab misses or when Blitzcrank is low on mana. Slow him with Karma Q Inner Flame, then keep Karma W Focused Resolve tethered to root him, and add movement speed with Karma E Inspire as your allies move in.
Blitzcrank.laning: Keep minions between you and Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab, but only look to hit Karma Q Inner Flame when Blitzcrank steps outside the minion line. If the enemy engages first, catch the engaging champion with Karma W Focused Resolve and use Karma E Inspire to pull your allied marksman out. Karma Q Inner Flame and Karma E Inspire cost a lot of mana, so don’t waste Karma Q Inner Flame on poke without a clear angle or on clearing minions.
Blitzcrank.phase: In the mid game, use the movement speed from Karma E Inspire and Karma E Inspire empowered by Karma R Mantra to roam with your allies or rotate to objectives. In the late game, focus more on team-wide shields and movement speed than single-target burst.
Blitzcrank.teamfight: Fight close to your backline allies and protect the target Blitzcrank is trying to grab. Then hit enemy champions with basic abilities to trigger Karma P Gathering Fire and bring Karma R Mantra up sooner.
Blitzcrank.watch: If Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab pulls you in, Blitzcrank E Power Fist can knock you up, followed by the silence from Blitzcrank R Static Field, so manage your distance with minions between you. When you lack vision in bushes, it’s hard to judge the range of an incoming grab, so stay well away from them. Blitzcrank R Static Field directly destroys shields, so don’t rely on Karma E Inspire’s shield to survive it.

Brand.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle early and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Brand’s damage is mostly magic, and Karma has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Brand P Blaze deals damage based on your max health, so avoid choices that greatly increase your health alone.
Brand.combo: When Brand W Pillar of Flame is down, slow Brand with Karma Q Inner Flame, then catch him with Karma W Focused Resolve to root him. Help your allies engage with Karma E Inspire while they attack. If Brand is already rooted or caught by allied crowd control, layer Karma Q Inner Flame empowered by Karma R Mantra over him to hit the area damage too.
Brand.escape: Brand has no mobility, so the moment he uses Brand W Pillar of Flame is your chance to close the distance. If you are ablaze, Brand Q Sear can stun you, so dodge the projectile or get behind a minion before moving in. If it’s hard to get close, cast Karma E Inspire on yourself for movement speed and get into range of Karma W Focused Resolve.
Brand.fight: Engage after Brand W Pillar of Flame is down if Brand remains within range. Slow him with Karma Q Inner Flame, then keep Karma W Focused Resolve tethered to root him, and help your allies move in with Karma E Inspire. Karma’s magic damage works well against Brand’s low magic resistance, so poke when you have a clear angle.
Brand.laning: Don’t go for last hits beside burning minions, and move aside if the wave is ablaze. Karma Q Inner Flame is blocked by minions, so use it when Brand steps outside the minion line. Since Karma Q Inner Flame and Karma E Inspire cost a lot of mana, don’t use Karma Q Inner Flame without a clear angle.
Brand.phase: During the middle of the laning phase, careless use of Karma Q Inner Flame and Karma E Inspire can drain your mana, so choose your poke opportunities. In the late game, focus more on the team-wide shield and movement speed from Karma E Inspire empowered by Karma R Mantra than on Karma’s single-target burst.
Brand.teamfight: Space out from allies to reduce the spread of Brand E Conflagration and the bounces from Brand R Pyroclasm, and don’t stand near an ally who is ablaze. If you need to stop an opponent from engaging, use Karma W Focused Resolve empowered by Karma R Mantra, then keep hitting enemy champions with abilities to get Karma R Mantra back sooner.
Brand.watch: Brand P Blaze stacks when you are hit by spells in quick succession, then explodes, so it’s important to dodge the first attack. Be especially careful to dodge Brand W Pillar of Flame, and if you are ablaze, move out of the line of Brand Q Sear’s projectile or hide behind a minion. Watch for Brand E Conflagration spreading near burning minions.

Braum.build: Use a Null-Magic Mantle early to withstand Braum’s magic damage. Karma has no ability to escape on her own, so stuns and knockups are especially dangerous; choose Mercury’s Treads for boots.
Braum.combo: When Braum W Stand Behind Me is down and you can avoid the frontal block from Braum E Unbreakable, slow him with Karma Q Inner Flame, then keep Karma W Focused Resolve tethered to root him. Follow up with Karma E Inspire to help your allies engage while they deal damage. If Braum is already rooted, layer Karma Q Inner Flame empowered by Karma R Mantra over him to aim for the area damage too.
Braum.escape: The moment you make Braum use Braum W Stand Behind Me is your window to close in and engage. If you are caught by Braum’s mark or Braum R Glacial Fissure, first use Karma E Inspire to create distance, then engage when Braum W Stand Behind Me is down.
Braum.fight: Keep your distance where minions block Braum Q Winter’s Bite, and poke with Karma Q Inner Flame when Braum steps outside the minion line. If Braum E Unbreakable is blocking from the front, wait or find an angle from the side. Right after Braum W Stand Behind Me is down, look for a chance to hit the slow from Karma Q Inner Flame and catch him with Karma W Focused Resolve.
Braum.laning: Stand behind minions to avoid Braum Q Winter’s Bite, and retreat before more stacks build if Braum P Concussive Blows marks you. When Braum engages, catch him with Karma W Focused Resolve and use Karma E Inspire to pull your allied marksman out. Save mana and cycle Karma R Mantra by using Karma Q Inner Flame when you have a clear angle to hit a champion.
Braum.phase: In the mid game, keep hitting with Karma Q Inner Flame to cycle Karma R Mantra, while staying out of range of Braum’s engage. In the late game, help your allies with the team-wide shield and movement speed from Karma E Inspire empowered by Karma R Mantra, rather than single-target damage.
Braum.teamfight: Avoid the line and slow zone from Braum R Glacial Fissure, and position to the side so allied damage isn’t funneled into the front blocked by Braum E Unbreakable. Then hit enemy champions with Karma’s basic abilities to get Karma R Mantra back, and target the champion Braum is protecting rather than focusing damage only on Braum.
Braum.watch: If you’re hit by Braum Q Winter's Bite or a basic attack and get marked by Braum P Concussive Blows, use Karma E Inspire’s movement speed to get out of range before the stun triggers. Don’t use Karma Q Inner Flame straight into Braum E Unbreakable while his shield is up; wait until it drops or you have an angle from the side. Watch Braum R Glacial Fissure’s cast animation and dodge straight to the side, and avoid stepping on the slow zone it leaves behind.

Cassiopeia.build: Cassiopeia’s main damage is magic and Karma has relatively low magic resistance, so buy a Null-Magic Mantle first. Choose Mercury’s Treads for boots.
Cassiopeia.combo: Slow her with Karma Q Inner Flame, then keep Karma W Focused Resolve tethered to root her. Layer Karma Q Inner Flame empowered by Karma R Mantra over the rooted target, and give your allies a shield and movement speed with Karma E Inspire as they move in.
Cassiopeia.escape: The moment Cassiopeia uses Cassiopeia W Miasma elsewhere is your chance to engage. Close the distance with the movement speed from Karma E Inspire and keep Karma W Focused Resolve tethered to catch her.
Cassiopeia.fight: If you are hit by Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast, don’t continue the fight; approach again after the poison ends.
Cassiopeia.laning: Karma Q Inner Flame is blocked by minions, so use it when Cassiopeia steps outside the minion line. Hit champions with abilities to trigger Karma P Gathering Fire and cycle Karma R Mantra, but don’t waste Karma Q Inner Flame on clearing minions when you have no clear angle.
Cassiopeia.phase: If you don’t build a lead here, Cassiopeia gets stronger in the mid to late game, so Karma should focus on team-wide shields and movement speed in the late game.
Cassiopeia.teamfight: Instead of charging straight at Cassiopeia, cut off her route or engage right after she uses Cassiopeia W Miasma.
Cassiopeia.watch: If you are poisoned by Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast, the damage and healing from Cassiopeia E Twin Fang increase, so stay out of range until the poison ends. When you see the cast animation for Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze, turn your back to avoid the stun.

Corki.build: Build armor first to withstand the physical damage from Corki E Gatling Gun and Corki R Missile Barrage. Armor won’t block the magic damage from Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb or Corki W Valkyrie, and resistance won’t reduce the true damage from Corki P Hextech Munitions, so consider building health too.
Corki.combo: When Corki W Valkyrie is down, slow him with Karma Q Inner Flame, then keep Karma W Focused Resolve tethered to root him. When your allies follow up, give them a shield and movement speed with Karma E Inspire.
Corki.escape: Right after Corki uses Corki W Valkyrie, he has no escape, creating an opening to engage. Use Karma E Inspire for movement speed to approach, or follow Karma Q Inner Flame’s slow with Karma W Focused Resolve.
Corki.fight: Don’t force an engage while Corki W Valkyrie is available. Just after he uses it, slow him with Karma Q Inner Flame and close the gap. Avoid the area in front of Corki E Gatling Gun, and use the shield and movement speed from Karma E Inspire to mitigate damage and maintain a favorable distance.
Corki.laning: Pressure Corki during his weak first five levels so he can’t farm comfortably. Use Karma Q Inner Flame when Corki steps out from behind his minions and you have a clear angle to hit him. This conserves mana and lets Karma P Gathering Fire reduce Karma R Mantra’s cooldown.
Corki.phase: Corki gets stronger as he builds items in the mid and late game, so don’t let him farm comfortably. In the late game, support your team with the area shield and movement speed from Karma R Mantra-empowered Karma E Inspire instead of focusing on single-target damage.
Corki.teamfight: When Corki R Missile Barrage deals area damage, shield nearby allies and give them movement speed with Karma R Mantra-empowered Karma E Inspire. If Corki W Valkyrie is down and you can catch him, chain Karma Q Inner Flame’s slow into Karma W Focused Resolve’s root. Then hit enemy champions with basic abilities to use Karma P Gathering Fire to reduce the cooldown of your next Karma R Mantra.
Corki.watch: Corki R Missile Barrage also damages enemies around the first target it hits, so don’t hide behind minions; move out of range instead. Reposition to avoid taking the third missile in quick succession. If Corki E Gatling Gun hits you, it reduces your armor and magic resistance, so move to the side instead of standing in front of it.

Diana.build: Diana deals mostly magic damage, and Karma has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Buy a Null-Magic Mantle early, and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots.
Diana.combo: If you can catch Diana after she engages, slow her with Karma Q Inner Flame, then follow with Karma W Focused Resolve to root her. Help your allies engage with Karma E Inspire while they deal damage.
Diana.escape: If Diana engages first with Diana E Lunar Rush without a Diana Q Crescent Strike mark, catch her when she can’t use her dash to return. Slow her with Karma Q Inner Flame and root her with Karma W Focused Resolve. After Diana marks you, account for her re-engage and use Karma E Inspire to create distance.
Diana.fight: Don’t fight Diana up close right after she activates Diana W Pale Cascade; wait for the orbs and shield to expire. Poke with Karma Q Inner Flame when Diana steps out from behind her minions, and use Karma E Inspire’s shield and movement speed just before she approaches.
Diana.laning: Save mana by using Karma Q Inner Flame only when you have a clear angle to hit a champion.
Diana.teamfight: Use vision to deny Diana a flank angle, and spread out so Diana R Moonfall doesn’t pull several of you in together. Then hit enemy champions with basic abilities to reduce the cooldown of your next Karma R Mantra.
Diana.watch: Diana Q Crescent Strike curves toward you, so sidestep it. If it marks you, Diana can follow with Diana E Lunar Rush, so immediately create distance. In teamfights, spread out so Diana R Moonfall doesn’t pull several of you in together.
Diana.phase: In the late game, Karma should focus on helping allies with shields and movement speed rather than single-target burst damage.

Ekko.build: Ekko deals mostly magic damage, and Karma has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Buy a Null-Magic Mantle early to withstand his damage, and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots.
Ekko.combo: Slow Ekko with Karma Q Inner Flame, then keep Karma W Focused Resolve tethered to root him. If he has just used Ekko E Phase Dive to get close, you can also try to catch him first with Karma W Focused Resolve.
Ekko.escape: If only Ekko E Phase Dive is down, Ekko can still escape with Ekko R Chronobreak, so don’t go in deep. Engage before Ekko R Chronobreak comes back up, especially during a window when Ekko W Parallel Convergence is also down. Slow him with Karma Q Inner Flame, then follow with Karma W Focused Resolve to root him.
Ekko.fight: Right after Ekko uses Ekko E Phase Dive to get close, he has no mobility spell available. Slow him with Karma Q Inner Flame, then follow with Karma W Focused Resolve to try to root him. If Ekko R Chronobreak is ready, don’t chase deep just because his health is low. Start a full fight when both Ekko W Parallel Convergence and Ekko R Chronobreak are down.
Ekko.laning: Karma Q Inner Flame is blocked by minions, so use it when Ekko steps out from behind his minions and you have a clear angle to hit him. If you see the signal for Ekko W Parallel Convergence, leave its area, and dodge the return path of Ekko Q Timewinder.
Ekko.phase: In the mid game, look for an opportunity to fight when Ekko R Chronobreak is down. In the late game, focus on area shields and movement speed from Karma R Mantra-empowered Karma E Inspire instead of Karma’s single-target burst damage.
Ekko.teamfight: Right after Ekko uses Ekko E Phase Dive to get close, root him with Karma W Focused Resolve to force out Ekko R Chronobreak or stop his engage. If Ekko tries to damage an ally, shield them and give them movement speed with Karma E Inspire so they can get away. If you need to protect several allies, use Karma R Mantra-empowered Karma E Inspire, then hit enemy champions with abilities to reduce the cooldown of your next R Mantra.
Ekko.watch: When you see the signal for Ekko W Parallel Convergence, leave the marked area to avoid the stun and shield. Ekko Q Timewinder deals more damage on the return hit, so also dodge its path back. When you see Ekko’s afterimage, Ekko R Chronobreak is ready; don’t chase recklessly, even if his health is low.

Fizz.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle early to withstand Fizz’s damage, and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Fizz deals mostly magic damage, so magic resistance is the resistance Karma needs.
Fizz.combo: When Fizz E Playful / Trickster is down, slow him with Karma Q Inner Flame, then catch and root him with Karma W Focused Resolve. If it’s hard to maintain distance, cast Karma E Inspire on yourself first so the tether doesn’t break.
Fizz.escape: Once Fizz E Playful / Trickster is on cooldown, you have an opportunity to engage with Karma W Focused Resolve. If Fizz Q Urchin Strike is still available, he can use it to escape, so confirm that both mobility spells are down before rooting him.
Fizz.fight: Trade just after Fizz E Playful / Trickster goes down. Slow him with Karma Q Inner Flame, then keep Karma W Focused Resolve tethered to root him. Hit him with abilities to reduce the cooldown of Karma R Mantra.
Fizz.laning: Look for the moment when Fizz misses a last hit with Fizz W Seastone Trident, putting it on its full cooldown. Use Karma Q Inner Flame when Fizz steps out from behind his minions and you can hit him, and don’t waste mana using it to clear minions. If Fizz engages, use Karma E Inspire’s shield and movement speed to create distance.
Fizz.phase: Manage your mana during the laning phase and look for an opening when Fizz E Playful / Trickster is down. In the late game, help your team with the area shield and movement speed from Karma R Mantra-empowered Karma E Inspire.
Fizz.teamfight: Stand close to an ally to bait out Fizz E Playful / Trickster, then focus him together once it’s down. If a fish from Fizz R Chum the Waters attaches to you, move away from your allies before it explodes.
Fizz.watch: If a fish from Fizz R Chum the Waters attaches to you, move away from your allies before the shark erupts. Slow Fizz with Karma Q Inner Flame along the path he uses to engage with Fizz Q Urchin Strike, and save Karma W Focused Resolve until Fizz E Playful / Trickster is down.

Galio.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle early to withstand his damage, and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Galio deals mostly magic damage, and Karma has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Galio.combo: When Galio steps out from behind his minions, slow him with Karma Q Inner Flame, then keep Karma W Focused Resolve tethered to root him. Place Karma R Mantra-empowered Karma Q Inner Flame on the spot where he is rooted to deal area damage. If your allies can follow up, help them engage with Karma E Inspire.
Galio.escape: Don’t engage just because Galio E Justice Punch is down. Look for an opening before Galio R Hero’s Entrance comes back up. Then slow him with Karma Q Inner Flame and catch him with Karma W Focused Resolve and Karma R Mantra.
Galio.fight: Karma has no ability to escape on her own, so keep a safe distance from Galio’s taunt and dash. When Galio steps forward to attack at close range or comes out from behind his minions, poke him with Karma Q Inner Flame to reduce Karma R Mantra’s cooldown. Stop trading and back away while Galio charges Galio W Shield of Durand.
Galio.laning: Look for an angle to poke Galio from range, but don’t waste mana by using Karma Q Inner Flame to clear minions. If Galio uses his abilities to clear the wave and runs low on mana, push the lane to limit his opportunity to affect other lanes with Galio R Hero’s Entrance. If you’re playing support, catch Galio with Karma W Focused Resolve when he engages, then use Karma E Inspire to get your allied marksman out.
Galio.phase: In the mid game, use Karma E Inspire’s movement speed to move with your allies, but don’t start a skirmish in another lane while Galio R Hero’s Entrance is ready. In the late game, focus on area shields and movement speed from Karma R Mantra-empowered Karma E Inspire instead of Karma’s single-target burst damage.
Galio.teamfight: If you see the landing marker for Galio R Hero’s Entrance, move out of its area. When your allies need to get out too, help them move with Karma E Inspire. Then hit enemy champions with basic abilities to reduce the cooldown of your next Karma R Mantra.
Galio.watch: When Galio charges Galio W Shield of Durand, it reduces the damage he takes and extends the taunt, so don’t unload your damage; move out of taunt range instead. Dodge when you see Galio step backward to wind up Galio E Justice Punch, and leave the point where the two gusts from Galio Q Winds of War overlap. If you see the landing marker for Galio R Hero’s Entrance, immediately move out of its area.

Heimerdinger.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle early, and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Heimerdinger’s main damage is magic, and Karma has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Heimerdinger.combo: Hit Heimerdinger with Karma Q Inner Flame to slow him, then keep Karma W Focused Resolve tethered to root him. Help your allies engage with Karma E Inspire. If you need to get close first, cast Karma E Inspire on yourself for movement speed and enter Karma W Focused Resolve’s range.
Heimerdinger.escape: Heimerdinger has no ability to create distance on his own, so approach by going around his turret setup, then catch him with Karma W Focused Resolve.
Heimerdinger.fight: Slow him with Karma Q Inner Flame, then keep Karma W Focused Resolve tethered to root him.
Heimerdinger.laning: Karma Q Inner Flame is blocked by minions, so use it when Heimerdinger steps out from behind them and you have a clear angle to hit him. Don’t waste it clearing minions. If Heimerdinger engages, catch him with Karma W Focused Resolve and use Karma E Inspire to get your allied marksman out.
Heimerdinger.phase: When joining a mid-game objective, it can be effective to use Karma R Mantra-empowered Karma E Inspire to help your team move, but watch out for Heimerdinger’s empowered grenade and don’t group up in one spot. In the late game, focus on keeping allies alive with shields and movement speed instead of single-target burst damage.
Heimerdinger.teamfight: If Heimerdinger R UPGRADE!!! is ready, don’t group up to face off in a narrow passage or in front of an objective. If you need to stop Heimerdinger’s engage, empower Karma W Focused Resolve with Karma R Mantra. If you need to withstand area damage, use empowered Karma E Inspire to protect nearby allies too. Then hit enemy champions with basic abilities to reduce the cooldown of your next R Mantra with Karma P Gathering Fire.

Hwei.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle early, and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Hwei deals mostly magic damage, so build magic resistance first.
Hwei.combo: Slow him with Karma Q Inner Flame, catch him with Karma W Focused Resolve, then cast Karma E Inspire on your allies when they engage.
Hwei.escape: Engage when Hwei E Subject: Torment is down. If it’s still available, the engage lead may be pushed away or rooted, so first confirm that it has been used. Then approach with Karma E Inspire’s movement speed and keep Karma W Focused Resolve tethered.
Hwei.fight: Close the gap just after Hwei uses Hwei E Subject: Torment to poke or clear minions. Slow him with Karma Q Inner Flame, then keep Karma W Focused Resolve tethered to root him.
Hwei.laning: Karma Q Inner Flame is blocked by minions, so poke Hwei when he steps out from behind them. Save mana when you don’t have a clear angle to hit him. If the enemy engages first, catch the champion who started it with Karma W Focused Resolve, then use Karma E Inspire to get your allied marksman out.
Hwei.phase: In the mid game, hit abilities to reduce the cooldown of Karma R Mantra while managing your mana. In the late game, support your team with area shields and movement speed.
Hwei.teamfight: When you need to stop an enemy engage, use Karma R Mantra-empowered Karma W Focused Resolve, then hit them with basic abilities to reduce the cooldown of your next Karma R Mantra.
Hwei.watch: If Hwei E Subject: Torment roots or forcibly moves you, you’re likely to take follow-up damage. If you’re hit by the first spell, reposition immediately to dodge the second spell and the explosion from Hwei P Signature of the Visionary.

Irelia.build: If healing from Irelia Q Bladesurge becomes a problem, rush Morellonomicon and apply Grievous Wounds with Karma Q Inner Flame. If Irelia E Flawless Duet’s stun is enabling engages that catch an allied carry, consider Mikael’s Blessing first.
Irelia.combo: When Irelia Q Bladesurge is down, cast Karma E Inspire on yourself to approach and keep Karma W Focused Resolve tethered. After the root lands, layer Karma R Mantra-empowered Karma Q Inner Flame to also hit with its area damage.
Irelia.escape: The moment Irelia Q Bladesurge is down is your window to approach. If Irelia engages first, survive with Karma R Mantra-empowered Karma W Focused Resolve, then escape with the shield and movement speed from Karma E Inspire.
Irelia.fight: Right after Irelia Q Bladesurge is down, use Karma E Inspire to close the distance and keep Karma W Focused Resolve tethered to look for a root.
Irelia.laning: Don’t leave a low-health minion between you and Irelia, and back away when minions are about to die. Save mana by using Karma Q Inner Flame only when Irelia is outside the minion line and you see a clear angle to hit her.
Irelia.phase: Later in the game, when levels and items have accumulated, focus less on Karma’s single-target burst and more on the teamwide shield and movement speed from Karma R Mantra-empowered Karma E Inspire.
Irelia.teamfight: Irelia R Vanguard’s Edge and Irelia E Flawless Duet can turn a team fight, so prioritize targeting Irelia. To stop her engage, use Karma R Mantra-empowered Karma W Focused Resolve; to protect several allies, use empowered Karma E Inspire.
Irelia.watch: Irelia Q Bladesurge can chain through low-health minions to close the distance, so back away as minions are about to die. Watch out for the stun from Irelia E Flawless Duet, and if you’re trapped inside Irelia R Vanguard’s Edge, don’t cross the boundary until the blades disappear.

Janna.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle early to withstand her damage, and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Janna deals mostly magic damage, so build magic resistance first. If the healing from Janna R Monsoon is a problem, consider Morellonomicon.
Janna.combo: Slow her with Karma Q Inner Flame, then follow with Karma W Focused Resolve to root her. Give your allies movement speed with Karma E Inspire when they engage. If it’s hard to get close, cast Karma E Inspire on yourself first to get in range of Karma W Focused Resolve.
Janna.escape: Once Janna Q Howling Gale misses and she uses Janna W Zephyr, you have an opening to close the gap. If Janna R Monsoon is also down, approach with Karma E Inspire and keep Karma W Focused Resolve tethered.
Janna.fight: If Janna uses Janna E Eye Of The Storm on an ally, focus your damage on them after the shield expires. Once Janna Q Howling Gale and Janna W Zephyr have been used without hitting you, close the gap with Karma E Inspire’s movement speed and catch her with Karma W Focused Resolve. Be careful about your engage distance because Janna R Monsoon can knock you back.
Janna.laning: Poke the ally Janna is protecting to make her use Janna E Eye Of The Storm. Take control after Janna Q Howling Gale and Janna W Zephyr miss. Save mana by using Karma Q Inner Flame when you have a clear angle to hit a champion without minions blocking it.
Janna.phase: In the mid game, use Karma E Inspire’s movement speed to roam with your allies or join them at objectives. In the late game, focus on area shields and movement speed from Karma R Mantra-empowered Karma E Inspire instead of single-target damage.
Janna.teamfight: If Janna is behind her allied damage dealers and knocking back engages, establish vision and look for a moment when she’s isolated. Janna R Monsoon can knock an engage back, so when you need to protect your allies, use Karma R Mantra-empowered Karma E Inspire. Then hit enemy champions with basic abilities to reduce the cooldown of your next Karma R Mantra with Karma P Gathering Fire.
Janna.watch: Janna Q Howling Gale knocks enemies airborne, so if you hear a tornado from a bush or outside your vision, dodge its path. A target affected by Janna E Eye Of The Storm gains a shield and attack damage, so don’t focus your damage on them while it’s active. Janna R Monsoon knocks away enemies who engage, so don’t go in deep while she can use it.

Kassadin.build: Early on, build a Null-Magic Mantle first to survive, and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Since Kassadin’s main damage is magic, build magic resistance first.
Kassadin.combo: Slow with Karma Q Inner Flame, then keep Karma W Focused Resolve tethered to root him. Use Karma E Inspire to help allies engage while they deal damage.
Kassadin.escape: Then slow him with Karma Q Inner Flame and catch him with Karma W Focused Resolve. After Kassadin uses Kassadin R Riftwalk repeatedly, he can run out of mana and lose his mobility, giving you a chance to counterattack.
Kassadin.fight: Deal damage after Kassadin Q Null Sphere is down, and use Karma W Focused Resolve to catch him when Kassadin R Riftwalk is down.
Kassadin.laning: Using unnecessary abilities near Kassadin reduces Kassadin E Force Pulse’s cooldown, so use Karma Q Inner Flame only when you see a clear angle to hit a champion. Look for a position where minions won’t block it, and clear waves from outside Kassadin’s range whenever possible.
Kassadin.phase: Later in the game, Kassadin may dive the backline and escape, so focus on protecting allies with shields and movement speed from Karma.
Kassadin.teamfight: Watch for Kassadin R Riftwalk engages and stay with the backline. Then hit enemy champions with basic abilities to use Karma P Gathering Fire to bring up the next Karma R Mantra sooner.
Kassadin.watch: Kassadin Q Null Sphere grants a shield that absorbs magic damage, so poke with Karma Q Inner Flame after it is down. Kassadin E Force Pulse slows, and Kassadin R Riftwalk is used to engage and disengage, so don’t stand alone within its range.

Leblanc.build: Early on, build a Null-Magic Mantle first to survive, and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. LeBlanc’s main damage is magic, and Karma has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Leblanc.combo: After LeBlanc W Distortion’s return expires or has been used, slow her with Karma Q Inner Flame and keep Karma W Focused Resolve tethered to root her. Layer Karma R Mantra-empowered Karma Q Inner Flame where she is rooted to also hit with its area damage. When allies go in together, use Karma E Inspire to shield them and grant movement speed.
Leblanc.escape: The moment you make LeBlanc use LeBlanc W Distortion is your chance to close the gap, but while she can return, wait until the return expires or has been used. In that window, chain the slow from Karma Q Inner Flame into the root from Karma W Focused Resolve. If LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains catches you, prioritize using Karma E Inspire to get outside the chain’s range over engaging.
Leblanc.fight: When LeBlanc W Distortion engages, use Karma E Inspire to absorb the damage and create distance. After LeBlanc W Distortion’s return expires or has been used, slow her with Karma Q Inner Flame and keep Karma W Focused Resolve tethered to look for a root. Karma’s magic damage is effective against LeBlanc, so poke when you see a clear angle to hit her and use Karma P Gathering Fire to bring Karma R Mantra back sooner.
Leblanc.laning: Karma Q Inner Flame is blocked by minions, so hit her with Karma Q Inner Flame when she steps outside the minion line. To avoid running out of mana, don’t waste Karma Q Inner Flame when you lack a clear angle to hit a champion. If LeBlanc pushes the lane and disappears from view, alert your team immediately, and only push a side lane after securing river vision.
Leblanc.phase: In the mid game, maintain vision to prepare for LeBlanc’s roams, and use Karma E Inspire to quickly join fights with allies. Later in the game, focus less on Karma’s single-target burst and more on the teamwide shield and movement speed from Karma R Mantra-empowered Karma E Inspire.
Leblanc.teamfight: If LeBlanc engages to catch an ally, respond with Karma W Focused Resolve and use Karma E Inspire to pull the ally out. If you need to turn around a catch, use the healing and extended root from Karma R Mantra-empowered Karma W Focused Resolve.
Leblanc.watch: If LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice’s mark is still active, her next ability will deal more damage, so don’t move forward; retreat until the mark disappears. If LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains hits you, use Karma E Inspire’s movement speed to get outside the chain’s range before the root lands. LeBlanc P Mirror Image’s clone can’t deal damage, so identify the one that is actually attacking before using abilities.

Leona.build: Early on, build a Null-Magic Mantle to survive, and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Leona deals mostly magic damage, and Karma has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. If Leona’s crowd control catches an allied carry, rush Mikael’s Blessing.
Leona.combo: After Leona E Zenith Blade is down, slow her with Karma Q Inner Flame and keep Karma W Focused Resolve tethered to root her. Use Karma E Inspire to help allies engage while they deal damage.
Leona.escape: Leona E Zenith Blade is her only mobility tool, so go in right after she uses it. Catch her with Karma W Focused Resolve and use Karma R Mantra to create a window where it’s hard for her to escape.
Leona.fight: The moment Leona E Zenith Blade is down is your chance to close the gap and counterattack. Until then, keep your distance and poke with Karma Q Inner Flame when Leona steps outside the minion line and you see a clear angle to hit her. Don’t trade at close range while Leona W Eclipse is active.
Leona.laning: Focus primarily on disengaging and protecting your allies. When Leona engages, catch her with Karma W Focused Resolve while using Karma E Inspire to pull your allied marksman out. Manage your mana by using Karma Q Inner Flame only when you have a clear angle to hit an enemy champion.
Leona.phase: In the mid game, poke with Karma Q Inner Flame to trigger Karma P Gathering Fire and cycle Karma R Mantra, while continuing to avoid Leona’s engage range. Later in the game, help allies with the teamwide shield and movement speed from Karma R Mantra-empowered Karma E Inspire instead of focusing on single-target burst.
Leona.teamfight: Leona P Sunlight marks signal that follow-up damage is coming, so retreat immediately. If Leona engages and catches an ally, catch her with Karma W Focused Resolve and use Karma E Inspire to pull the ally out. To stop an engage, use Karma R Mantra-empowered Karma W Focused Resolve; when you need to absorb area damage, empower Karma E Inspire, then hit with basic abilities to bring up the next Karma R Mantra sooner.
Leona.watch: Leona E Zenith Blade pierces in a straight line and pulls her to the last champion hit, so don’t stand in a line with your allied marksman. Leona Q Shield of Daybreak can be activated before she approaches, so the key is not to give her room to get close. When the marker for Leona R Solar Flare appears, move sideways to avoid the center stun, and leave the area before Leona W Eclipse explodes.

Lissandra.build: Early on, build a Null-Magic Mantle first to survive, and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Lissandra deals mostly magic damage, and Karma has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. If Lissandra’s engage catches your allied marksman, rush Mikael’s Blessing.
Lissandra.combo: When Lissandra E Glacial Path is down or after she uses Lissandra W Ring of Frost, slow her with Karma Q Inner Flame and keep Karma W Focused Resolve tethered to root her. Use Karma E Inspire to help allies engage while they deal damage.
Lissandra.escape: Lissandra E Glacial Path is her only mobility tool, so the moment she uses it is your window to close the gap. If Lissandra W Ring of Frost is also down, use the movement speed from Karma E Inspire to approach and keep Karma W Focused Resolve tethered. While Lissandra E Glacial Path is traveling, aim to land Karma W Focused Resolve’s root before it can be used again.
Lissandra.fight: Look to trade right after Lissandra W Ring of Frost is used on the wave or misses. If Lissandra E Glacial Path is also down, slow her with Karma Q Inner Flame and keep Karma W Focused Resolve tethered to look for a root. Karma’s magic damage is effective against Lissandra, so use abilities when you have a clear angle to hit her and cycle Karma R Mantra with Karma P Gathering Fire.
Lissandra.laning: Stand at an angle to allied minions to avoid the path of Lissandra Q Ice Shard. Use Karma Q Inner Flame when Lissandra steps outside the minion line and you see a clear angle to hit her; don’t waste mana on clearing minions. If Lissandra engages, catch her with Karma W Focused Resolve and use Karma E Inspire to pull your allied marksman out.
Lissandra.phase: In the mid game, move with allies using Karma E Inspire to help with mid lane ganks or rotations to objectives. Later in the game, focus less on single-target damage and more on the teamwide shield and movement speed from Karma R Mantra-empowered Karma E Inspire.
Lissandra.teamfight: Check whether Lissandra has used Lissandra E Glacial Path, and look for a chance to catch her if it’s down. To stop Lissandra’s engage, empower Karma W Focused Resolve with Karma R Mantra; to protect several allies, empower Karma E Inspire with Karma R Mantra. Even after using your first Karma R Mantra, hit enemy champions with basic abilities to use Karma P Gathering Fire to bring up the next Karma R Mantra sooner.
Lissandra.watch: Lissandra Q Ice Shard pierces through its target and continues behind them, so don’t stand in a line with allied minions. Lissandra W Ring of Frost can root you, and Lissandra R Frozen Tomb can stun you, making follow-up damage easy to land, so manage your distance first. If Lissandra can cast Lissandra R Frozen Tomb on herself, don’t pour in all your damage at once; spread it out even after the stasis ends.

Lulu.build: Early on, build a Null-Magic Mantle to survive, and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Lulu deals mostly magic damage, and Karma has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Lulu.combo: When Lulu steps out from behind minions, slow her with Karma Q Inner Flame, then keep Karma W Focused Resolve tethered to root her. Use Karma E Inspire to help allies engage while they deal damage, and layer Karma R Mantra-empowered Q Inner Flame where Lulu is rooted.
Lulu.escape: The moment Lulu W Whimsy is used on another ally is your chance to close the gap. Approach with the movement speed from Karma E Inspire and follow up with Karma W Focused Resolve, but don’t force it if the slow from Lulu Q Glitterlance or the knockup from Lulu R Wild Growth is still available.
Lulu.fight: Instead of taking an all-in from Lulu, keep up steady poke with Karma Q Inner Flame. Hit Q when Lulu steps out from behind minions, then follow up on the slowed Lulu with Karma W Focused Resolve to look for a root.
Lulu.laning: Stand behind minions to reduce the bonus damage from Lulu P Pix, Faerie Companion. Use Karma Q Inner Flame when you have a clear angle to hit Lulu, and if she engages first, catch her with Karma W Focused Resolve and use Karma E Inspire to pull your allied marksman out.
Lulu.phase: In the mid game, cycle Karma R Mantra with poke while conserving mana. Later in the game, help allies with Karma E Inspire and its empowered teamwide shield instead of focusing on single-target damage.
Lulu.teamfight: If Lulu R Wild Growth is available, target Lulu or someone else instead of pouring all your damage into the ally she is protecting.
Lulu.watch: If Lulu W Whimsy hits you, you’re silenced and can’t cast abilities, so don’t force an approach while her W is available. Keep your distance to avoid being slowed by Lulu Q Glitterlance and then knocked up by Lulu R Wild Growth.

Lux.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first to survive Lux’s magic damage. Choose Mercury’s Treads for boots to gain both magic resistance and tenacity.
Lux.combo: After dodging Lux Q Light Binding, slow her with Karma Q Inner Flame and keep Karma W Focused Resolve tethered to root her. Use Karma E Inspire to help allies engage while they deal damage. Layer Karma R Mantra-empowered Karma Q Inner Flame where Lux is rooted to also hit with its area damage.
Lux.escape: Go in right after you bait Lux Q Light Binding and make it miss. Lux has no mobility ability to create distance, so approach with the movement speed from Karma E Inspire and catch her with Karma W Focused Resolve.
Lux.fight: The moment Lux Q Light Binding misses is your chance to close the gap. Slow her with Karma Q Inner Flame, then keep Karma W Focused Resolve tethered to root her, and use Karma P Gathering Fire to bring Karma R Mantra back sooner each time you deal damage. If Lux hits you with an ability, get outside her basic attack range before Lux P Illumination is triggered by a basic attack.
Lux.laning: Stand apart from allies to the side so you aren’t hit together by Lux Q Light Binding. Use Karma Q Inner Flame when Lux steps outside the minion line and you see a clear angle to hit her, and don’t waste mana clearing minions. If the enemy engages first, catch the engaging champion with Karma W Focused Resolve and use Karma E Inspire to pull your allied marksman out.
Lux.phase: In the mid-game laning phase, manage the mana costs of Karma Q Inner Flame and Karma E Inspire and focus on poke you can land. Later in the game, support allies with the teamwide shield and movement speed from Karma R Mantra-empowered Karma E Inspire instead of focusing on single-target burst.
Lux.teamfight: Split your approach angles with allies so you aren’t caught together in Lux E Lucent Singularity. When you need to absorb Lux’s area damage, use Karma R Mantra-empowered Karma E Inspire to shield nearby allies and grant them movement speed. Keep hitting with Karma’s basic abilities to use Karma P Gathering Fire to bring up the next Karma R Mantra sooner.
Lux.watch: If Lux Q Light Binding hits you, follow-up abilities are easy to land, so don’t stand in a line with allies and bait out Q to dodge it. Use Karma E Inspire’s movement speed to leave the area affected by Lux E Lucent Singularity. When you see the red targeting line from Lux R Final Spark, dodge sideways.

Malzahar.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first, then choose Mercury’s Treads. Malzahar’s main damage is magic, so prioritize magic resistance.
Malzahar.combo: First remove Malzahar P Void Shift with Karma Q Inner Flame. Then slow him with another Karma Q Inner Flame or use Karma E Inspire’s movement speed to close in, and keep the tether from Karma W Focused Resolve on him to root him. While he is rooted, layer Karma R Mantra-empowered Karma Q Inner Flame, and give your allies movement speed and a shield with Karma E Inspire as they engage.
Malzahar.escape: Avoid Malzahar Q Call of the Void’s silence and remove Malzahar P Void Shift before engaging. It’s also an opportunity when the minions summoned by Malzahar W Void Swarm have disappeared or have not spawned yet. Malzahar has no ability to create distance on his own, but don’t engage alone if he can cast Malzahar R Nether Grasp.
Malzahar.fight: If Malzahar P Void Shift is active, remove it first with Karma Q Inner Flame before engaging. Karma Q Inner Flame is blocked by minions, so hit Malzahar when he steps out from behind them, then keep the tether from Karma W Focused Resolve on him while he is slowed.
Malzahar.laning: Early on, use your advantage from having access to Karma R Mantra to pressure Malzahar and deny him time to scale. If he casts E Malefic Visions on the wave, move away from the minions, and use Karma Q Inner Flame when you see an angle to hit him. If Malzahar has pushed the lane, coordinate with your jungler and engage after removing Malzahar P Void Shift.
Malzahar.phase: From mid game onward, keep pressuring the lane and joining your jungler to deny Malzahar time to scale. Malzahar gets stronger as the game goes on, so in the late game, focus Karma on supporting allies with the area-wide shield and movement speed from Karma R Mantra-empowered Karma E Inspire over single-target damage.
Malzahar.teamfight: If minions from Malzahar W Void Swarm are already out, clear them first with an area spell such as Karma Q Inner Flame. If an ally is suppressed by Malzahar R Nether Grasp, another ally must use immobilizing crowd control on Malzahar to interrupt the cast. When you need to protect allies, use Karma R Mantra-empowered Karma E Inspire, then hit an enemy champion with a basic ability to bring Karma R Mantra back sooner.
Malzahar.watch: Stay away from minions affected by Malzahar E Malefic Visions, since the damage can transfer to you when they die. When you see Malzahar Q Call of the Void, move outward from between the two rifts to avoid the silence. Malzahar R Nether Grasp’s suppression cannot be removed by Karma E Inspire’s shield or movement speed, so don’t pass through areas without vision alone while Malzahar can cast R.

Maokai.build: Maokai’s damage is mostly magic, and Karma has low magic resistance, so buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury’s Treads. Choose later resistances based on the enemy damage dealer who can deal damage while Maokai holds you. Consider Morellonomicon if enemy healing becomes a problem.
Maokai.combo: After Maokai W Twisted Advance is down, cast Karma E Inspire on yourself to close in, then root him with Karma W Focused Resolve. Layer Karma R Mantra-empowered Q Inner Flame on the spot where he is rooted so he also takes the area damage. If Maokai has caught you, use the healing and longer root from Karma R Mantra-empowered W Focused Resolve, and pull your allies back with Karma E Inspire.
Maokai.escape: Your window to engage Maokai is just after he uses Maokai W Twisted Advance. If Maokai W Twisted Advance and R Nature’s Grasp are ready, keep your distance because Karma has no ability to get away on her own.
Maokai.fight: When Maokai W Twisted Advance is ready, stay out of range near brush. Just after it is down, close the distance with Karma E Inspire’s movement speed and keep the tether from Karma W Focused Resolve on him to root him. When poking, hit an enemy damage dealer with Karma Q Inner Flame so you don’t bring forward the cooldown of Maokai P Sap Magic’s healing.
Maokai.laning: As support Karma, your default response when Maokai engages is to hold him with Karma W Focused Resolve and pull your allied marksman back with Karma E Inspire. Karma Q Inner Flame is blocked by minions, so use it when an enemy damage dealer steps beyond the minion line. To avoid running out of mana, don’t waste Karma Q Inner Flame on minions when there’s no angle to hit an enemy.
Maokai.phase: In mid game, move with your allies using Karma E Inspire, and when joining them, Karma R Mantra-empowered E Inspire can speed up nearby allies too. In the late game, focus on keeping allies alive with an area-wide shield and movement speed over single-target burst damage.
Maokai.teamfight: Fight in open terrain where there’s room to dodge Maokai R Nature’s Grasp, and move perpendicular to its direction of travel when you see a wall. Then hit with basic abilities to bring the next Karma R Mantra forward with Karma P Gathering Fire.
Maokai.watch: Maokai W Twisted Advance dashes in and roots, and Maokai can’t be targeted during the dash, so use your abilities after he lands. Don’t enter brush where Maokai E Sapling Toss is present; if a sapling chases you, lead it toward minions or monsters instead of your allies. Maokai R Nature’s Grasp roots for longer when it comes from far away, so dodge perpendicular to its direction of travel.

Mel.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Mel deals mostly magic damage, so prioritize building magic resistance.
Mel.combo: If Mel W Rebuttal is down, slow her with Karma Q Inner Flame and catch her with Karma W Focused Resolve to root her. Layer Karma R Mantra-empowered Q Inner Flame where she is rooted, and grant movement speed and a shield with Karma E Inspire when allies go in. If it’s hard to start with Q, cast E on yourself first to approach within W range.
Mel.escape: Avoid the center of Mel E Solar Snare; once Mel W Rebuttal is down, that’s your chance to engage. Mel has no mobility ability, so close the gap with Karma E Inspire and keep Karma W Focused Resolve tethered to root her.
Mel.fight: After making Mel use W Rebuttal, slow her with Karma Q Inner Flame and go in when you can keep Karma W Focused Resolve tethered. Use Karma E Inspire just before going in to gain its shield and movement speed.
Mel.laning: Mel gets stronger over time, so push or pressure the lane early to limit her room to scale. Use Karma Q Inner Flame when Mel steps outside the minion line and you see a clear angle to hit her; don’t waste it on minions. Hit with abilities to keep cycling Karma R Mantra with Karma P Gathering Fire.
Mel.phase: In the mid game, keep pressuring Mel so she has no room to stack growth. Later in the game, Mel grows stronger as she stacks, and Karma’s single-target burst falls short, so help allies with teamwide shields and movement speed.
Mel.teamfight: When area damage such as Mel Q Radiant Volley comes in, use Karma R Mantra-empowered E Inspire to shield nearby allies. If Mel’s root puts an ally at risk, intervene with Karma W Focused Resolve and use E Inspire to help the ally escape. Even after using your first Karma R Mantra, hit with basic abilities to use Karma P Gathering Fire to bring up the next Karma R Mantra sooner.
Mel.watch: Mel W Rebuttal sends projectiles back, so use a basic attack to make her use W before casting Karma Q Inner Flame. Mel E Solar Snare roots you if you’re hit in the center, so dodge to the side; if you’ve been hit multiple times and Overwhelm has stacked up, retreat even if you still have health.
