If stacks remain after the fight, watch out for Mel R Golden Eclipse, which has no range limit, and wait somewhere safe.

Milio.build: Survive early with a Null-Magic Mantle, then choose Mercury’s Treads. Most of Milio’s damage is magic, but it is low, so choose later resistances based on the enemy damage dealers. If the healing from Milio W Cozy Campfire and Milio R Breath of Life becomes a problem, get Morellonomicon and apply Grievous Wounds to multiple enemies with Karma Q Inner Flame.
Milio.combo: When Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick is down, slow him with Karma Q Inner Flame, keep the tether from Karma W Focused Resolve on him to root him, and help your allies engage with Karma E Inspire. If it’s awkward to get close, cast Karma E Inspire on yourself first for movement speed, then move into Karma W Focused Resolve range.
Milio.escape: Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick is his only way to disengage, so treat the window after it is down as your chance to engage. Once you close the distance, use the slow from Karma Q Inner Flame or the movement speed from Karma E Inspire to maintain the tether from Karma W Focused Resolve.
Milio.fight: After Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick is down, slow him with Karma Q Inner Flame, close the distance, and look for a root with Karma W Focused Resolve. Karma Q Inner Flame is blocked by minions, so use it when Milio steps beyond the minion line.
Milio.laning: Early on, land poke against Milio’s composition to trigger Karma P Gathering Fire, cycle R Mantra, and take control of the wave. Use Karma Q Inner Flame when you see an angle to hit a champion, and don’t waste mana using it to clear minions. If the enemy engages first, hold the initiating champion with Karma W Focused Resolve and pull your allied marksman back with Karma E Inspire.
Milio.phase: From mid game onward, keep in mind that Milio’s composition gets stronger as the game goes on, and buy Grievous Wounds earlier if healing becomes a problem. In the late game, Karma should help allies with the area-wide shield and movement speed from Karma R Mantra-empowered Karma E Inspire over single-target burst damage.
Milio.teamfight: If Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick is down and you can get onto him, consider holding Milio first to shut down the enemy’s sustain. Then hit an enemy champion with a basic ability to trigger Karma P Gathering Fire and bring the next R Mantra back sooner.
Milio.watch: Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick knocks back and slows the first enemy it hits, so don’t force an engage while it’s available. If Milio W Cozy Campfire is active and extends the enemy marksman’s range, delay the frontline fight and let the duration run out.

Morgana.build: Survive early with a Null-Magic Mantle, then choose Mercury’s Treads. Morgana’s main damage is magic, and her root and stun open the way for follow-up attacks, so prioritize magic resistance and tenacity. If your allied carry is rooted often, get Mikael’s Blessing earlier; consider Morellonomicon if Morgana’s healing becomes a problem.
Morgana.combo: If Morgana E Black Shield is down, slow her with Karma Q Inner Flame, then keep the tether from Karma W Focused Resolve on her to root her. Give your allies a shield and movement speed with Karma E Inspire as they go in to attack. Layer Karma R Mantra-empowered Karma Q Inner Flame on the rooted target to also deal area damage.
Morgana.escape: Morgana has no ability to create distance on her own, so when Morgana Q Dark Binding is down is your chance to close in. If Morgana E Black Shield is also down, engage and catch her with Karma W Focused Resolve. If it’s awkward to get close, cast Karma E Inspire on yourself for movement speed, but if Morgana R Soul Shackles catches you, get out of range before it stuns you.
Morgana.fight: Poke with Karma Q Inner Flame from a position where you can dodge Morgana Q Dark Binding, and cycle R Mantra again. Don’t try to root a target with Karma W Focused Resolve while Morgana E Black Shield is active on them. After Black Shield and the root are down, slow her with Karma Q Inner Flame and close the distance.
Morgana.laning: Keep minions between you and Morgana so Morgana Q Dark Binding can’t reach you directly. Use Karma Q Inner Flame when you have an angle to hit an enemy champion, and don’t spend mana just to clear minions. If Morgana engages, catch the initiating champion with Karma W Focused Resolve and pull your allied marksman back with Karma E Inspire.
Morgana.phase: From mid game onward, manage your mana by choosing chances to hit with Karma Q Inner Flame and cycle R Mantra. In the late game, help your allies with the area-wide shield and movement speed from Karma R Mantra-empowered Karma E Inspire over single-target burst damage.
Morgana.teamfight: If Morgana Q Dark Binding or Morgana R Soul Shackles threatens an allied carry, use Karma E Inspire to shield them from damage and help them move. Karma E Inspire can’t remove an immobilizing effect from an ally who is already affected, so if you bought Mikael’s Blessing early, use it for that situation.
Morgana.watch: Morgana Q Dark Binding roots only the first target it hits, so move with minions between you and her. If it hits, Morgana W Tormented Shadow and follow-up attacks can come next, and the pool is more dangerous when your health is low. Morgana R Soul Shackles stuns after its chains attach and some time passes, so move out of range immediately with Karma E Inspire’s movement speed when you see it.

Naafiri.build: Build armor and health first to withstand Naafiri’s damage. If the healing from Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers and Naafiri E Eviscerate becomes a problem, buy Morellonomicon and apply Grievous Wounds with Karma Q Inner Flame.
Naafiri.combo: After Naafiri’s mobility ability is down, slow her with Karma Q Inner Flame and keep the tether from Karma W Focused Resolve on her to root her. Layer Karma R Mantra-empowered Karma Q Inner Flame on the spot where she is rooted, and use Karma E Inspire to help allies engage or disengage.
Naafiri.escape: Don’t engage just because Naafiri E Eviscerate is down. Look for a chance to catch her with Karma W Focused Resolve when Naafiri R Hounds’ Pursuit is still on cooldown and her other mobility ability is also down. If Naafiri W The Call of the Pack is active, wait until it ends before using targeted abilities.
Naafiri.fight: Poke with Karma Q Inner Flame, but use it when Naafiri steps beyond the minion line and you see an angle to hit her. Counterattack just after Naafiri E Eviscerate is down by clearing the pack with Karma Q Inner Flame, and don’t chase far if she still has another mobility ability.
Naafiri.laning: Farm and poke from behind the minion line, taking advantage of Naafiri’s melee range.
Naafiri.phase: In mid game, watch for Naafiri’s roams and maintain broad vision. In the late game, group with your allies to limit Naafiri’s angles to engage, and use the area-wide shield and movement speed from Karma R Mantra-empowered Karma E Inspire.
Naafiri.teamfight: Watch for Naafiri R Hounds’ Pursuit by grouping with allies, and retreat immediately if an ally dies so you aren’t picked off one after another. Then hit an enemy champion with a basic ability to bring the next Karma R Mantra forward.
Naafiri.watch: If Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers hits you once, use Karma E Inspire to create distance until the bleed ends and avoid the second hit. While Naafiri W The Call of the Pack is active, hold your targeted abilities, and don’t travel alone if Naafiri R Hounds’ Pursuit is ready.

Nami.build: Survive early with a Null-Magic Mantle, then choose Mercury’s Treads. Nami’s damage is mostly magic, and Karma has relatively low magic resistance, so prioritize magic resistance. If Nami Q Aqua Prison or Nami R Tidal Wave can catch your allied carry, get Mikael’s Blessing earlier; consider Morellonomicon if the healing from Nami W Ebb and Flow becomes a problem.
Nami.combo: If Nami Q Aqua Prison misses, slow her with Karma Q Inner Flame, then keep the tether from Karma W Focused Resolve on her to root her. Help your allies engage with Karma E Inspire while they attack.
Nami.escape: Just after Nami Q Aqua Prison misses, go in on Nami while you have a window after dodging the stun. Sidestep Nami R Tidal Wave when you see it, and if Nami E Tidecaller’s Blessing is active, approach again after it ends. Close the distance with Karma E Inspire’s movement speed, or retreat with your allies if things get dangerous.
Nami.fight: Just after Nami Q Aqua Prison misses is a good chance to target her. Nami has low health and no mobility ability, so hit her with Karma Q Inner Flame when she steps beyond the minion line, slow her, and close the distance. Don’t fight straight into a target affected by Nami E Tidecaller’s Blessing; wait for the effect to end.
Nami.laning: Karma Q Inner Flame is blocked by minions, so use it when you see an angle to hit Nami, and don’t waste mana with unnecessary casts. Hold vision and look for attack angles on Nami’s side, but if the enemy engages first, hold the initiating champion with Karma W Focused Resolve and pull your allied marksman back with Karma E Inspire.
Nami.phase: In mid-game lane, manage the mana costs of Karma Q Inner Flame and Karma E Inspire while landing poke on Nami to cycle R Mantra. In the late game, focus on supporting allies with the area-wide shield and movement speed from Karma R Mantra-empowered Karma E Inspire over single-target damage.
Nami.teamfight: When Nami engages with Q Aqua Prison or R Tidal Wave, manage your spacing so your allies aren’t caught next, and use Mikael’s Blessing if an allied carry is caught. If you need to interrupt an enemy engage, use Karma R Mantra-empowered Karma W Focused Resolve; when area damage comes in, use empowered Karma E Inspire. Then hit an enemy champion with a basic ability to bring the next R Mantra forward with Karma P Gathering Fire.
Nami.watch: Nami Q Aqua Prison falls slowly, but if it hits, the stun can lead into follow-up attacks, so sidestep when you see it coming. Nami R Tidal Wave also needs to be dodged to the side as soon as you see it, since the crowd control that follows a hit is dangerous. Don’t fight head-on against a target affected by Nami E Tidecaller’s Blessing; fight again after the effect ends.

Nautilus.build: Nautilus’s main damage is magic, and Karma has relatively low magic resistance, so buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury’s Treads. If Nautilus’s engage often catches your allied marksman, get Mikael’s Blessing earlier. Karma E Inspire’s shield alone cannot remove crowd control.
Nautilus.combo: If Nautilus Q Dredge Line is down, slow him with Karma Q Inner Flame, then keep the tether from Karma W Focused Resolve on him to root him. Help your allies engage with Karma E Inspire while they deal damage.
Nautilus.escape: Make Nautilus use Q Dredge Line; if it misses, that’s your chance to engage. Slow him with Karma Q Inner Flame and root him with Karma W Focused Resolve to make it difficult for him to close the distance again.
Nautilus.fight: Close the distance and trade just after Nautilus Q Dredge Line misses. Before Nautilus can get back on top of you, slow him with Karma Q Inner Flame and look for a root when you can maintain the tether from Karma W Focused Resolve. Don’t prolong a trade within range of Nautilus P Staggering Blow.
Nautilus.laning: Stand behind minions to block Nautilus Q Dredge Line, and use Karma Q Inner Flame when the enemy steps beyond the minion line and you see an angle to hit. If Nautilus engages, hold him with Karma W Focused Resolve and pull your allied marksman back with Karma E Inspire. To avoid running out of mana, don’t waste Karma Q Inner Flame on minions.
Nautilus.phase: In mid game, keep hitting with abilities to cycle Karma R Mantra through Karma P Gathering Fire, while first managing Nautilus’s engage range. In the late game, focus on supporting allies with the area-wide shield and movement speed from Karma R Mantra-empowered Karma E Inspire over single-target burst damage.
Nautilus.teamfight: Nautilus R Depth Charge can knock up allies along its path, so don’t stand on top of one another. If you need to interrupt Nautilus’s engage, use Karma R Mantra-empowered Karma W Focused Resolve; if you need to protect allies from area damage, use empowered Karma E Inspire. Then hit an enemy champion with a basic ability to bring the next Karma R Mantra forward with Karma P Gathering Fire.
Nautilus.watch: Nautilus Q Dredge Line starts his engage and follow-up crowd control, so dodge it by keeping minions between you and him. Don’t linger within attack range where you could be rooted by the first attack from Nautilus P Staggering Blow. When Nautilus R Depth Charge is available, don’t stand in its path with your allies.

Neeko.build: Neeko’s main damage is magic, and Karma has low magic resistance, so buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. If Neeko E Tangle-Barbs is likely to root an allied carry, get Mikael’s Blessing earlier. Karma E Inspire’s shield cannot remove crowd control.
Neeko.combo: After Neeko E Tangle-Barbs is down, slow her with Karma Q Inner Flame, root her with Karma W Focused Resolve, then use Karma E Inspire to help your allies engage. If you can’t get close, cast Karma E Inspire on yourself for the movement speed, then connect Karma W Focused Resolve.
Neeko.escape: If Neeko roots you instead, use the healing from Karma W Focused Resolve empowered by Karma R Mantra to survive.
Neeko.fight: If Neeko E Tangle-Barbs is down, slow her with Karma Q Inner Flame, then keep Karma W Focused Resolve tethered to root her. Karma’s magic damage is effective against Neeko, but getting caught can lead to more hits, so manage your distance first.
Neeko.laning: Karma Q Inner Flame is blocked by minions, so use it when Neeko steps beyond the minion line and you have a clear shot. If Neeko engages, root her with Karma W Focused Resolve and use Karma E Inspire to get your allied ranged carry out.
Neeko.phase: In the mid game, check whether Neeko R Pop Blossom is available and fight while it’s down. Late game, support your allies with the teamwide shield and movement speed from Karma E Inspire empowered by Karma R Mantra.
Neeko.teamfight: If an approaching opponent may be Neeko in disguise, spread out with your allies without waiting to see the windup for Neeko R Pop Blossom. Then hit enemy champions with Karma’s basic abilities to reduce your next R Mantra’s cooldown through Karma P Gathering Fire.
Neeko.watch: Neeko E Tangle-Barbs grows larger and faster after hitting its first target, so don’t overlap with allies or line up behind them. If an unexpected enemy approaches after Neeko disappears from view, suspect it’s her in disguise, and spread out before Neeko R Pop Blossom detonates. Don’t chase the clone from Neeko W Shapesplitter.

Orianna.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first, then choose Mercury’s Treads. Orianna’s damage is mostly magic, and Karma has relatively low magic resistance, so prioritize magic resistance.
Orianna.combo: When Orianna Q Command: Attack leaves the ball away from her, slow her with Karma Q Inner Flame and keep the tether from W Focused Resolve on her to root her. If it’s hard to get close, speed yourself up with Karma E Inspire, then use W Focused Resolve.
Orianna.escape: The window to close the distance is after Orianna W Command: Dissonance’s slow and R Command: Shockwave’s forced movement are down. Orianna has no ability to create distance on her own, so approach with Karma E Inspire and maintain the tether from W Focused Resolve.
Orianna.fight: Trade just after Orianna Q Command: Attack moves the ball away from her. From an angle that isn’t blocked by minions, slow her with Karma Q Inner Flame, and avoid fights where you take repeated attacks empowered by Orianna P Clockwork Windup.
Orianna.laning: Use Karma Q Inner Flame when you see an angle to hit Orianna, and don’t waste it on minions. Hit with abilities to bring R Mantra back sooner through Karma P Gathering Fire, while managing the mana costs of Karma Q Inner Flame and E Inspire.
Orianna.phase: In mid game, manage your mana and cycle R Mantra by landing abilities. In the late game, focus on supporting allies with an area-wide shield and movement speed over Karma’s single-target burst damage.
Orianna.teamfight: Position away from Orianna’s ball, and use the area-wide shield and movement speed from Karma R Mantra-empowered E Inspire on allies at risk of being hit by Orianna R Command: Shockwave. If you need to stop an enemy engage, use Karma R Mantra-empowered W Focused Resolve. Then hit with basic abilities to bring the next R Mantra forward through Karma P Gathering Fire.
Orianna.watch: After Orianna Q Command: Attack moves the ball, watch the ball’s position rather than Orianna herself. You can be pulled by Orianna R Command: Shockwave if you stand near the ball, so move away from it, and if you expect the slow from Orianna W Command: Dissonance, use Karma E Inspire’s shield and movement speed in advance.

Pantheon.build: Pantheon’s main damage is physical, so build armor first. Pantheon W Shield Vault deals damage based on your max health, so avoid choices that only greatly increase your health.
Pantheon.combo: When you have a chance to reach Pantheon, slow him with Karma Q Inner Flame, then keep Karma W Focused Resolve tethered to root him. As your allies deal damage, use Karma E Inspire to help them engage.
Pantheon.escape: Once Pantheon W Shield Vault is down, look for a chance to engage with Karma W Focused Resolve. If Pantheon R Grand Starfall is still on cooldown, he has fewer ways to escape, so use Karma R Mantra to keep him locked down. If only Pantheon W Shield Vault is down, account for Pantheon R Grand Starfall as an escape.
Pantheon.fight: Poke with Karma Q Inner Flame from outside Pantheon W Shield Vault’s range, and land hits to refresh Karma R Mantra. Deal damage after Pantheon E Aegis Assault ends or when you get to his side. If Pantheon engages, root him with Karma W Focused Resolve and use Karma E Inspire to get your allies out.
Pantheon.laning: Early trades with Pantheon are costly, so stay out of Pantheon W Shield Vault range. Stand behind minions to avoid Pantheon Q Comet Spear, but Karma Q Inner Flame is blocked by minions, so use it when Pantheon steps beyond the minion line. Spamming Karma Q Inner Flame and Karma E Inspire drains your mana, so use them when you have a clear hit or escape opportunity.
Pantheon.phase: Pantheon has less influence late game, while Karma focuses more on teamwide shields and movement speed support.
Pantheon.teamfight: If you need to stop Pantheon’s engage, use Karma W Focused Resolve empowered by Karma R Mantra. If you also need to protect your allies, use empowered Karma E Inspire. Pantheon W Shield Vault can lock down an allied carry, so cast Karma E Inspire just before they engage or retreat to help with both damage mitigation and movement. Then keep hitting enemy champions with Karma’s basic abilities to refresh Karma R Mantra.
Pantheon.watch: Pantheon W Shield Vault targets and stuns, so stay out of its range. Pantheon E Aegis Assault blocks damage from the front; wait until it ends or attack from the side. When you see the landing indicator for Pantheon R Grand Starfall, move out of its landing area.

Pyke.build: Consider armor over magic resistance against Pyke’s damage, but also get health to account for his armor penetration and Pyke R Death From Below. If Pyke E Phantom Undertow often stuns an allied carry, get Mikael’s Blessing earlier. Consider Morellonomicon if healing from Pyke P Gift of the Drowned Ones is a problem.
Pyke.combo: Slow Pyke with Karma Q Inner Flame, then keep Karma W Focused Resolve tethered to root him. As your allies deal damage, use Karma E Inspire to help them engage.
Pyke.escape: Right after dodging Pyke E Phantom Undertow is a chance to engage, but account for Pyke R Death From Below as an escape if it’s still available. Before Pyke R Death From Below comes back up, use Karma W Focused Resolve and Karma R Mantra to keep him locked down.
Pyke.fight: Keep your distance while Pyke still has a way to grab you. Dodge Pyke E Phantom Undertow to the side, then slow Pyke with Karma Q Inner Flame at the position where he ends up, and root him with Karma W Focused Resolve when you can maintain the tether. When poking, choose an angle where Karma Q Inner Flame reaches Pyke without being blocked by minions.
Pyke.laning: Focus on protecting your allies as they retreat. If Pyke engages, root him with Karma W Focused Resolve and cast Karma E Inspire on your allied ranged carry to get them out. Keeping vision when Pyke backs off after a trade can prevent healing from Pyke P Gift of the Drowned Ones.
Pyke.phase: In the mid game, use the movement speed from Karma E Inspire to roam with your allies or join them at objectives. Late game, focus on protecting allies with the teamwide shield and movement speed from Karma E Inspire empowered by Karma R Mantra rather than on single-target burst.
Pyke.teamfight: Avoid standing on top of low-health allies to avoid the area damage and chained executions from Pyke R Death From Below. Then hit enemy champions with your basic abilities to reduce your next Karma R Mantra’s cooldown through Karma P Gathering Fire.
Pyke.watch: If Pyke Q Bone Skewer pulls you, he can follow up with more crowd control, so manage your distance first. When Pyke E Phantom Undertow starts, move to the side of its dash path to avoid the stun. If the shark shadow from Pyke W Ghostwater Dive appears beneath you, retreat toward your allies or under your turret.

Qiyana.build: Qiyana’s main damage is physical, so build armor first. You don’t need to build magic resistance just for the magic damage from Qiyana W Terrashape. If Qiyana’s crowd control is likely to lock down an allied carry, get Mikael’s Blessing earlier.
Qiyana.combo: If Qiyana’s mobility ability is down, slow her with Karma Q Inner Flame, then keep Karma W Focused Resolve tethered to root her. Layer Q empowered by Karma R Mantra on the rooted target to hit them with the area effect too. When your allies engage with you, use Karma E Inspire to give them a shield and movement speed.
Qiyana.escape: If only Qiyana W Terrashape is down, Qiyana can escape with Qiyana E Audacity, so don’t rush your engage. Go in right after Qiyana has used both W and E and spent her combo, especially before E comes back up. Use Karma W Focused Resolve to root her during that window and make use of Karma R Mantra.
Qiyana.fight: Karma has no ability to escape on her own, so manage your distance first. Trade when Qiyana has used Qiyana W Terrashape and Qiyana E Audacity and is still in front of you. Look for a chance to catch her with Karma W Focused Resolve before Qiyana E Audacity comes back up.
Qiyana.laning: Poke when Qiyana steps beyond the minion line and you have a clear shot with Karma Q Inner Flame. Conserve mana by not wasting Q on clearing minions, and land abilities to refresh R Mantra through Karma P Gathering Fire. If Qiyana dives in, root her with Karma W Focused Resolve and use Karma E Inspire to get your allies out.
Qiyana.phase: Qiyana is strongest in the mid game, so keep your distance to avoid giving her an advantage in the early and mid game. Late game, help allies with the teamwide shield and movement speed from E Inspire empowered by Karma R Mantra. Move together, but spread out near terrain where Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent can detonate.
Qiyana.teamfight: Position away from walls and narrow passages to reduce Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent angles. If Qiyana engages, root her with Karma W Focused Resolve and use Karma E Inspire to get your allies out.
Qiyana.watch: Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal roots with river element and can ambush from stealth with brush element. If she approaches with river element, move out of range; if she disappears with brush element, move into your allies’ vision. Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent explodes on terrain and stuns, so keep your back off walls and avoid meeting her in narrow passages by the river.

Rakan.build: In the early game, survive with a Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Rakan’s main damage is magic, and Karma has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Rakan.combo: After Rakan W Grand Entrance misses, slow him with Karma Q Inner Flame, then keep Karma W Focused Resolve tethered to root him. Use Karma E Inspire to help your allies engage while they attack. If Rakan is already rooted, layer Karma Q Inner Flame empowered by Karma R Mantra on him to hit him with the area effect too.
Rakan.escape: Make Rakan use Rakan W Grand Entrance, then close the distance right after dodging the knockup. Root him with Karma W Focused Resolve, using the slow from Karma Q Inner Flame or the movement speed from Karma E Inspire to keep the tether from breaking. When Rakan is alone and separated from his allies, he can’t use Rakan E Battle Dance to reach them, so look for a chance to catch him.
Rakan.fight: Look to trade right after the shield from Rakan P Fey Feathers is removed. From an angle where minions won’t block it, slow him with Karma Q Inner Flame, then root him with Karma W Focused Resolve when you can get close. Land abilities to refresh Karma R Mantra through Karma P Gathering Fire.
Rakan.laning: Focus on managing your distance. If Rakan engages with Rakan W Grand Entrance, avoid the landing spot, then root him with Karma W Focused Resolve and use Karma E Inspire to get your allied ranged carry out. Use Karma Q Inner Flame when you have a clear shot at an enemy champion, and conserve mana by not wasting it on clearing minions.
Rakan.phase: In the mid game, move with your allies using Karma E Inspire to help them roam and join objectives. Late game, focus on the teamwide shield and movement speed from Karma E Inspire empowered by Karma R Mantra rather than on single-target burst.
Rakan.teamfight: Root Rakan with Karma W Focused Resolve right after Rakan W Grand Entrance lands to make it difficult for him to escape. Stay within range to interrupt Rakan R The Quickness with Karma W Focused Resolve before it reaches you, and protect allies from area damage with Karma E Inspire empowered by Karma R Mantra. Then hit enemy champions with your basic abilities to refresh Karma R Mantra sooner.
Rakan.watch: Rakan W Grand Entrance shows its landing spot in advance, so sidestep when he starts the dash to avoid the knockup. When Rakan R The Quickness is active, it’s hard to escape on foot, so don’t line up; cast Karma W Focused Resolve on him before he reaches you or put terrain between you.

Rell.build: In the early game, first survive Rell’s magic damage with a Null-Magic Mantle, and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. If Rell’s crowd control is likely to lock down your allied ranged carry, get Mikael’s Blessing earlier. The shield from Karma E Inspire alone can’t remove crowd control.
Rell.combo: If Rell’s engage ability is down, slow her with Karma Q Inner Flame, then keep Karma W Focused Resolve tethered to root her. When your allies follow up, use Karma E Inspire to give them movement speed.
Rell.escape: Don’t engage just because Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down is down. While Rell E Full Tilt is also down and she can’t use it again, slow her with Karma Q Inner Flame and look for a root with Karma W Focused Resolve. If Rell catches you, survive with the healing and long root from Karma W Focused Resolve empowered by Karma R Mantra.
Rell.fight: From outside Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down range, poke Rell with Karma Q Inner Flame when she steps beyond the minion line. Rell has low magic resistance early and no way to heal in lane, so it’s advantageous to trade by chipping away at her health while staying out of engage range. Stop trading and create distance when Rell E Full Tilt is active.
Rell.laning: If Rell engages, root her with Karma W Focused Resolve and use Karma E Inspire to get your allied ranged carry out. Apply Karma E Inspire’s shield after Rell Q Shattering Strike is down.
Rell.phase: In the mid game, keep out of Rell’s engage range while poking with Karma Q Inner Flame and helping allies move with Karma E Inspire. Late game, focus on the teamwide shield and movement speed from Karma E Inspire empowered by Karma R Mantra rather than on single-target burst.
Rell.teamfight: Before engaging, spread out from allies so you aren’t pulled in with them by Rell R Magnet Storm. Then hit enemy champions with your basic abilities to reduce your next Karma R Mantra’s cooldown through Karma P Gathering Fire.
Rell.watch: When Rell E Full Tilt speeds up Rell and one ally, watch for Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down to engage, stop trading, and move out of its range. Rell Q Shattering Strike breaks shields, so sidestep it and use Karma E Inspire after Rell Q Shattering Strike is down. Before a team fight, spread out from allies so several of you aren’t pulled in by Rell R Magnet Storm.

Renata.build: In the early game, survive with a Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Renata Glasc deals mostly magic damage, so build magic resistance first. If Renata Glasc Q Handshake catches an allied carry, get Mikael’s Blessing earlier.
Renata.combo: When Renata Glasc steps beyond the minion line, slow her with Karma Q Inner Flame, then keep Karma W Focused Resolve tethered to root her. Use Karma E Inspire to help your allies engage while they attack. Layer Karma Q Inner Flame empowered by Karma R Mantra on the rooted target to hit them with the area effect too.
Renata.escape: Once Renata Glasc Q Handshake is down, look for a chance to close the distance. Renata has no mobility ability of her own, so approach with Karma E Inspire and maintain the tether from Karma W Focused Resolve. If Renata Glasc R Hostile Takeover is still available, engage while keeping space between yourself and your allies.
Renata.fight: Hit Renata outside the minion line with Karma Q Inner Flame to slow her, then root her with Karma W Focused Resolve when you can get close. Use Karma E Inspire to help your allies engage.
Renata.laning: Use Karma Q Inner Flame when you have a clear shot at Renata Glasc, and don’t waste mana clearing minions. If Renata engages, root her with Karma W Focused Resolve and use Karma E Inspire to get your allied ranged carry out. Renata Glasc E Loyalty Program travels in a straight line, so sidestep it and then pressure Renata herself.
Renata.phase: In the mid game, use the movement speed from Karma E Inspire to roam with your allies or join them at objectives. Late game, focus on the teamwide shield and movement speed from E Inspire empowered by Karma R Mantra rather than Karma’s single-target burst.
Renata.teamfight: Keep space between allies while Renata Glasc R Hostile Takeover is available. If Renata Glasc Q Handshake catches an allied carry, the shield from Karma E Inspire alone can’t remove crowd control, so use Mikael’s Blessing.
Renata.watch: If Renata Glasc Q Handshake hits you, it roots you and then throws you in a direction Renata chooses, potentially stunning your allies too, so dodge it from behind minions or your frontline. While Renata Glasc R Hostile Takeover is available, approach with space between allies; if you’re hit, cleanse the crowd control or move away from your allies.

Ryze.build: In the early game, survive with a Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Ryze’s main damage is magic, and Karma has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Ryze.combo: Slow Ryze with Karma Q Inner Flame, then keep Karma W Focused Resolve tethered to root him. Give your allies movement speed with Karma E Inspire when they engage. If you’re unsure whether you can get close enough, cast Karma E Inspire on yourself first, then move into Karma W Focused Resolve range.
Ryze.escape: After dodging Ryze E Spell Flux, Ryze W Rune Prison won’t root you, so look for a chance to slow him with Karma Q Inner Flame and catch him with Karma W Focused Resolve.
Ryze.fight: If Ryze E Spell Flux marks you, don’t stay in place for his follow-up. Use the shield and movement speed from Karma E Inspire to manage your distance.
Ryze.laning: Poke aggressively before Ryze gets his items to slow his scaling. Karma Q Inner Flame is blocked by minions, so look for it when Ryze steps beyond the minion line, and don’t cast if you don’t have a clear shot so you don’t run out of mana.
Ryze.phase: In the mid game, focus on slowing Ryze’s scaling before he gets his items. Late game, Karma supports allies with teamwide shields and movement speed rather than single-target burst.
Ryze.teamfight: If you’re marked by Ryze E Spell Flux, move away from allies to avoid empowered Ryze Q Overload spreading to those around you.
Ryze.watch: If Ryze E Spell Flux marks you, move away from allies until the mark disappears, and watch for the follow-up root from Ryze W Rune Prison and empowered Ryze Q Overload. If you dodge Ryze E Spell Flux, Ryze W Rune Prison only slows, so focus on dodging E first.

Senna.build: Build armor early to withstand Senna’s main damage. Senna P Absolution adds damage to her basic attacks based on your current health, so build armor along with health instead of stacking health alone. Consider Morellonomicon if the healing from Senna Q Piercing Darkness becomes a problem.
Senna.combo: Slow Senna with Karma Q Inner Flame, then maintain the tether from Karma W Focused Resolve to root her. Use Karma E Inspire to help an ally engage, then place Karma R Mantra-empowered Karma Q Inner Flame on Senna’s rooted position.
Senna.escape: After Senna W Last Embrace is down, close the distance and use Karma W Focused Resolve. Senna has no ability to create distance herself, but Senna E Curse of the Black Mist can increase her movement speed, so use the slow from Karma Q Inner Flame or the speed boost from Karma E Inspire when closing in.
Senna.fight: Poke Senna with Karma Q Inner Flame when she steps forward to collect souls. If Q hits and slows her, maintain the tether from Karma W Focused Resolve to set up a root. If it is hard to get close, use Karma E Inspire to gain movement speed. Hit your poke abilities to trigger Karma P Gathering Fire and refresh Karma R Mantra sooner.
Senna.laning: Watch soul locations in advance and poke Senna as she approaches to interrupt her collection. Use Karma Q Inner Flame when you see an angle to hit Senna. To dodge Senna Q Piercing Darkness, move out of the line between Senna and the minion in front of her.
Senna.phase: Keep disrupting Senna’s soul collection in the mid game, and use Karma E Inspire to help allies move when regrouping. In the late game, Senna’s range and attack damage grow as she collects souls, so focus Karma on team-wide shields and movement speed support.
Senna.teamfight: When Senna E Curse of the Black Mist appears, back away and move to a visible area, or cast Karma Q Inner Flame into the mist to deter an engage. When you need to interrupt the enemy’s engage, use Karma R Mantra-empowered Karma W Focused Resolve, then hit abilities afterward to refresh Karma R Mantra.
Senna.watch: Senna Q Piercing Darkness travels in a straight line through allies or minions, so move out of its path. Dodge Senna W Last Embrace from behind minions. If it hits you, move away from your allies before the root takes hold. If Senna hits you once, back off so she cannot land a second attack and collect mist.

Seraphine.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle early and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Seraphine’s damage is mostly magic, and Karma has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Prioritize Mikael’s Blessing sooner if allied carries are getting caught by immobilizing crowd control.
Seraphine.combo: Slow Seraphine with Karma Q Inner Flame, then maintain the tether from Karma W Focused Resolve to root her, and use Karma E Inspire to help allies engage while they attack. If the distance is awkward, cast Karma E Inspire on yourself for movement speed, then use Karma W Focused Resolve.
Seraphine.escape: The moment after dodging Seraphine E Beat Drop is your chance to close the distance. Seraphine has no mobility ability, so slow her with Karma Q Inner Flame and maintain the tether from Karma W Focused Resolve to catch her. Conversely, if you are slowed, prioritize getting out of the line of Seraphine E Beat Drop over engaging.
Seraphine.fight: Trade when Seraphine is alone, away from her marksman, or after Seraphine E Beat Drop is down. Hit Seraphine with Karma Q Inner Flame when she steps beyond the minion line, then close the distance and maintain the tether from Karma W Focused Resolve. Since getting caught by her crowd control makes follow-up hits easy to land, manage your distance before engaging.
Seraphine.laning: Use Karma Q Inner Flame when you see an angle to hit Seraphine, and save mana by not wasting it on clearing minions. If the enemy engages first, catch the champion who started the engage with Karma W Focused Resolve and use Karma E Inspire to pull your allied marksman out.
Seraphine.phase: During the mid-game laning phase, manage the mana costs of Karma Q Inner Flame and Karma E Inspire and choose your poke opportunities. In the late game, focus less on single-target burst and more on the team-wide shield and movement speed from Karma R Mantra-empowered Karma E Inspire.
Seraphine.teamfight: Spread out to either side so Seraphine R Encore cannot follow an ally and reach the back line. Then keep hitting enemy champions with basic abilities to bring forward your next Karma R Mantra through Karma P Gathering Fire.
Seraphine.watch: Seraphine E Beat Drop roots slowed targets and stuns targets who are immobilized. If you are slowed, move out of its line instead of staying in front of her. In teamfights, Seraphine R Encore can charm allies behind the front line too, so spread out to either side.

Sona.build: Early on, withstand Sona’s magic damage with Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. If the healing from Sona W Aria of Perseverance becomes a problem, build Morellonomicon and apply its healing reduction to multiple targets with Karma Q Inner Flame. If Sona R Crescendo catches an allied carry, Karma E Inspire cannot remove the stun, so prioritize Mikael’s Blessing sooner.
Sona.combo: When Sona steps forward, slow her with Karma Q Inner Flame, maintain the tether from Karma W Focused Resolve to root her, then use Karma E Inspire to help your allies engage. When empowering Q with Karma R Mantra, place the zone over Sona’s rooted position to hit her with the delayed damage too. If there is no angle for Q but you can get close, cast Karma E Inspire on yourself for movement speed, then use W.
Sona.escape: Engage when Sona R Crescendo is down or when Sona steps forward to apply her aura. If Sona speeds up with Sona E Song of Celerity, a slow alone may not keep her in range, so slow her with Karma Q Inner Flame and maintain the tether from Karma W Focused Resolve to root her.
Sona.fight: Poke Sona with Karma Q Inner Flame when she steps forward to apply her aura beyond the minion line. This makes her spend mana on healing, while Karma can refresh Karma R Mantra faster by landing abilities.
Sona.laning: Use Karma Q Inner Flame when you see an angle to hit Sona, and manage your mana by not wasting it on clearing minions. If Sona engages first, catch her with Karma W Focused Resolve and use Karma E Inspire to pull your allied marksman out.
Sona.phase: In the mid game, keep looking for chances to punish Sona when she steps forward to apply her aura, but the matchup becomes harder over time because of her permanent stacks and team healing. In the late game, focus less on single-target burst and more on the team-wide shield and movement speed from Karma R Mantra-empowered E Inspire.
Sona.teamfight: Spread out to either side so Sona R Crescendo does not hit multiple allies. When Sona steps forward, look for a chance to catch her with Karma W Focused Resolve and separate her from her team. Keep hitting enemy champions with basic abilities to bring forward your next Karma R Mantra through Karma P Gathering Fire.
Sona.watch: Sona R Crescendo stuns every ally hit in a line, so spread out to either side instead of lining up when Sona steps forward. If Sona suddenly enters basic attack range, watch for the empowered attack from Sona P Power Chord and create distance early.

Soraka.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle early and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Soraka’s damage is mostly magic, so prioritize magic resistance. If her healing becomes a problem, build Morellonomicon to reduce it.
Soraka.combo: Slow Soraka with Karma Q Inner Flame, then catch her with Karma W Focused Resolve to root her, and use Karma E Inspire to help an ally follow up. If you have a better angle to approach than to land Q, cast Karma E Inspire on yourself first to get into W range. Place the zone from Karma R Mantra-empowered Q over the W root or an ally’s crowd control.
Soraka.escape: Engage once Soraka E Equinox has been used for poke or wave clear. Use Karma E Inspire to speed up your approach before stepping into the silence zone, then maintain the tether from Karma W Focused Resolve to root her.
Soraka.fight: The moment after Soraka E Equinox is down is your chance to engage. Slow her with Karma Q Inner Flame, then maintain the tether from Karma W Focused Resolve to root her. Concentrate your damage in a short window and target Soraka herself. Karma’s magic damage is effective against Soraka’s low magic resistance.
Soraka.laning: Pressure Soraka’s allied marksman to force her to use Soraka W Astral Infusion, which costs Soraka health. Avoid Soraka Q Starcall to keep up this pressure. Karma Q Inner Flame is blocked by minions, so land it when Soraka steps beyond them; if there is no angle, save your mana.
Soraka.phase: In the mid game, move with allies using Karma E Inspire to help with mid lane ganks or objective rotations. In the late game, focus less on single-target burst and more on the team-wide shield and movement speed from Karma R Mantra-empowered E.
Soraka.teamfight: Target Soraka herself instead of repeatedly attacking only the ally she is healing. Then keep hitting enemy champions with basic abilities to trigger Karma P Gathering Fire and bring forward your next Karma R Mantra.
Soraka.watch: Soraka Q Starcall slows, heals, and increases movement speed, so manage your distance to avoid it. Soraka E Equinox silences you and can then root you, so use Karma E Inspire to escape before stepping into its zone. Soraka R Wish heals allies regardless of distance, so account for it even when an enemy is close to being killed.

Swain.build: Swain deals mostly magic damage, and Karma has relatively low magic resistance, so buy Null-Magic Mantle first. Choose Mercury’s Treads for boots.
Swain.combo: When Swain E Nevermove is down, slow him with Karma Q Inner Flame, then maintain the tether from Karma W Focused Resolve to root him. Use Karma E Inspire to help allies engage while they deal damage. If Swain is rooted, place Karma R Mantra-empowered Karma Q Inner Flame over him to aim for the zone’s follow-up damage too.
Swain.escape: Engage after dodging the returning wave from Swain E Nevermove or right after the ability is down. Swain has no escape ability, so use Karma E Inspire to approach and maintain the tether from Karma W Focused Resolve for a chance to catch him.
Swain.fight: Take the initiative early with Karma Q Inner Flame pokes before Swain builds stacks. If you dodge Swain E Nevermove, close the distance with Karma E Inspire’s movement speed and maintain the tether from Karma W Focused Resolve to root him. Keep your distance normally to avoid being hit by multiple bolts from Swain Q Death’s Hand.
Swain.laning: Karma Q Inner Flame is blocked by minions, so use it only when Swain steps beyond the minion line and you have an angle to hit him. If Swain engages first, catch him with Karma W Focused Resolve and use Karma E Inspire to pull your allies out.
Swain.phase: From the mid game onward, Swain becomes harder to catch this way as he gains permanent stacks from Swain P Ravenous Flock. In the late game, focus less on Karma’s single-target burst and more on the team-wide shield and movement speed from Karma R Mantra-empowered Karma E Inspire.
Swain.teamfight: When Swain R Demonic Ascension is active, use Karma E Inspire to help allies get out of its range, then fight again after his ultimate ends.
Swain.watch: Swain E Nevermove roots you if you are hit by the wave as it travels out or returns, and he can then pull you in for a combo. After dodging the first wave, stay out of its path until it has completely disappeared. More bolts from Swain Q Death’s Hand overlap and hit you at close range, so keep your distance.

Sylas.build: Sylas deals primarily magic damage, and Karma has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Early on, withstand his damage with Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Consider Morellonomicon if the healing from Sylas W Kingslayer becomes a problem.
Sylas.combo: Slow Sylas with Karma Q Inner Flame, then maintain the tether from Karma W Focused Resolve to root him. If it is hard to stay close, cast Karma E Inspire on yourself for movement speed. Place Karma R Mantra-empowered Q Inner Flame on his rooted position to hit him with the delayed explosion too.
Sylas.escape: After dodging the second chain from Sylas E Abscond / Abduct, especially before the ability comes back up, you have a chance to engage. If Sylas W Kingslayer is still available, he can use it to escape, so do not dive deep just because one mobility ability is down. When engaging, slow him with Karma Q Inner Flame and maintain the tether from Karma W Focused Resolve to root him.
Sylas.fight: Karma Q Inner Flame is blocked by minions, so land it when Sylas steps beyond them. Hitting him triggers Karma P Gathering Fire and brings Karma R Mantra back sooner. If Sylas engages on you, catch him with Karma W Focused Resolve and use Karma E Inspire to manage the distance.
Sylas.laning: Use Karma Q Inner Flame when you see an angle to hit a champion, and do not waste it on clearing minions and running out of mana. Save room to use Karma E Inspire to dodge the chains from Sylas E Abscond / Abduct.
Sylas.phase: In the mid game, use Karma W Focused Resolve and Karma E Inspire to handle Sylas’s engages while moving with your allies. In the late game, support your team with the team-wide shield and movement speed from Karma R Mantra-empowered E Inspire instead of relying on single-target damage.
Sylas.teamfight: Right after Sylas engages with Sylas E Abscond / Abduct, catch him with Karma W Focused Resolve to give your allies time to attack before Sylas can heal with Sylas W Kingslayer. Then keep hitting enemy champions with basic abilities to bring forward your next R Mantra through Karma P Gathering Fire.
Sylas.watch: With Sylas E Abscond / Abduct, the chains that follow the first dash are the dangerous part. If they hit, you are knocked up and take a follow-up combo, so use the movement speed from Karma E Inspire to dodge the chains and immediately leave the intersection point of Sylas Q Chain Lash as well. Sylas W Kingslayer heals more as his health gets lower, so do not delay finishing him after you have reduced his health.

Syndra.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle early and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Build magic resistance first to withstand Syndra’s main damage. Also consider your total health to survive the true damage from Syndra W Force of Will and the execute from Syndra R Unleashed Power.
Syndra.combo: Once Syndra E Scatter the Weak is down, slow her with Karma Q Inner Flame, then maintain the tether from Karma W Focused Resolve to root her. If it is hard to get close, cast Karma E Inspire on yourself for movement speed and get into range for Karma W Focused Resolve. Once she is rooted, place Karma R Mantra-empowered Karma Q Inner Flame over her to aim for the zone damage too.
Syndra.escape: Syndra E Scatter the Weak has a long cooldown and is her only self-peel, so engage right after it is down. Before engaging, move out of the sphere’s line to avoid a stun angle, then close the distance with the movement speed from Karma E Inspire.
Syndra.fight: The moment after Syndra E Scatter the Weak is down is your chance to fight up close. When Syndra steps beyond the minion line, slow her with Karma Q Inner Flame and use Karma W Focused Resolve to root her if you can close the distance. Hit enemy champions with Karma abilities to trigger Karma P Gathering Fire and refresh Karma R Mantra sooner.
Syndra.laning: Get boots early so you can walk out of the spots where Syndra Q Dark Sphere, Syndra W Force of Will, and Syndra E Scatter the Weak are telegraphed. Karma Q Inner Flame is blocked by minions, so use it when you see an angle to hit Syndra, and do not waste mana on clearing minions.
Syndra.phase: The available information is not enough to judge the relative advantage in the mid game. In the late game, focus less on Karma’s single-target burst and more on the team-wide shield and movement speed from Karma R Mantra-empowered Karma E Inspire.
Syndra.teamfight: Avoid areas with many Syndra Q Dark Spheres and watch out for Syndra R Unleashed Power. Then keep hitting enemy champions with basic abilities to bring forward your next Karma R Mantra through Karma P Gathering Fire.
Syndra.watch: If Syndra Q Dark Sphere is between Syndra and you, Syndra E Scatter the Weak can push it into you and stun you, so move out of the sphere’s line. Move away from areas where Syndra has placed several Q Dark Spheres, as Syndra R Unleashed Power becomes more dangerous there. When your health is low, watch out for the execute from Syndra R Unleashed Power.

Talon.build: Talon deals physical damage, so buy armor such as Cloth Armor early, then build health as well. If Talon’s high magic resistance blocks Karma’s magic damage, add magic penetration. Consider Morellonomicon if the healing from Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy becomes a problem.
Talon.combo: When Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy is down, slow him with Karma Q Inner Flame, then root him with Karma W Focused Resolve. If it is hard to get close, increase your movement speed with Karma E Inspire and get into range for Karma W Focused Resolve. Place Karma R Mantra-empowered Karma Q Inner Flame over the spot where the root lands.
Talon.escape: Right after making Talon use Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy, a window opens to engage with Karma W Focused Resolve. If you confirm Talon R Shadow Assault is down too, counterattack during the window when he cannot escape with stealth.
Talon.fight: The moment after Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy is used is your chance to close the distance and catch him. Slow him with Karma Q Inner Flame and maintain the tether from Karma W Focused Resolve to root him. If you have confirmed Talon R Shadow Assault has already been used, look for a counterattack.
Talon.laning: Use Karma Q Inner Flame when you see an angle to hit the enemy, while avoiding angles where minions block it and unnecessary mana costs. Share information about Talon’s position and place vision along jungle routes to prepare for Talon’s roams.
Talon.phase: In the mid game, watch for Talon’s terrain-crossing roams with vision and position sharing. Talon’s influence declines in the late game, so group up and fight while Karma provides allies with shields and movement speed.
Talon.teamfight: If Talon gets into the back line, catch him with Karma W Focused Resolve and give allies time to layer crowd control. When you need to block area damage, use Karma R Mantra-empowered Karma E Inspire to give nearby allies shields and movement speed. Then keep hitting enemy champions with basic abilities to bring forward your next Karma R Mantra through Karma P Gathering Fire.
Talon.watch: If you are hit as Talon W Rake travels out, first move out of its return path. Being hit twice strengthens Talon P Blade’s End’s combo. While Talon R Shadow Assault is available, account for its stealth and movement speed increase and do not chase recklessly.

Taric.build: Start with Null-Magic Mantle to survive the lane, then buy Mercury's Treads. Most of Taric's damage is magic, and Karma has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. If Taric E Dazzle often catches your carry, get Mikael's Blessing sooner. If Taric Q Starlight's Touch healing is a problem, buy Morellonomicon.
Taric.combo: When engaging, slow with Karma Q Inner Flame, keep Karma W Focused Resolve tethered to root, then use Karma E Inspire to help your allies follow up. If it is hard to get close, cast Karma E Inspire on yourself for the movement speed and get in range for Karma W Focused Resolve.
Taric.escape: Engage when Taric E Dazzle is down and the stun threat has passed. Taric has no skill to create distance on his own, so look for a chance to hold him with Karma W Focused Resolve after slowing him with Karma Q Inner Flame. If Taric engages instead, cast Karma E Inspire on an ally just before they retreat, and use the healing from Karma W Focused Resolve empowered by Karma R Mantra to sustain Karma while she is caught.
Taric.fight: Dodge or bait out Taric E Dazzle, then keep your distance and poke with Karma Q Inner Flame. Use Karma E Inspire's movement speed to manage spacing so Taric can't approach and keep auto-attacking. When you have an opening to engage, slow him with Karma Q Inner Flame, then keep Karma W Focused Resolve tethered to root him.
Taric.laning: Use Karma Q Inner Flame when Taric steps beyond the minion wall and you have a clear angle to hit him; save mana by not using it to clear minions. If Taric engages, hold him with Karma W Focused Resolve and use Karma E Inspire to pull your ranged carry back.
Taric.phase: In the mid game, land Karma Q Inner Flame poke to trigger Karma P Gathering Fire and cycle Karma R Mantra, then move with your team using Karma E Inspire's movement speed. In the late game, focus on the teamwide shield and movement speed from Karma E Inspire empowered by Karma R Mantra rather than single-target damage.
Taric.teamfight: When you see Taric R Cosmic Radiance begin its cast, decide whether to have your allies retreat or stop an enemy damage dealer. While damage immunity is active, stop attacking and root an enemy with Karma W Focused Resolve to run out the duration, then resume attacking when it ends. To interrupt an enemy engage, use Karma W Focused Resolve empowered by Karma R Mantra; to protect several allies, use empowered Karma E Inspire, then land basic abilities to get your next Karma R Mantra sooner.
Taric.watch: Taric E Dazzle stuns after a delay, so sidestep when you see it coming. When Taric R Cosmic Radiance grants damage immunity, stop attacking and wait for it to end.

Thresh.build: Start with Null-Magic Mantle to survive the lane, then buy Mercury's Treads. Most of Thresh's damage is magic, so build magic resistance, but tenacity against crowd control is also important because Karma has no skill to escape on her own. If Thresh's engage catches your ranged carry, get Mikael's Blessing sooner.
Thresh.combo: After Thresh's mobility is down, slow him with Karma Q Inner Flame, keep Karma W Focused Resolve tethered to root him, then use Karma E Inspire to help your allies engage. If you are too far away to get close, cast Karma E Inspire on yourself for the movement speed, then use Karma W Focused Resolve.
Thresh.fight: When Thresh steps forward to collect souls, trade if you have an angle to hit him with Karma Q Inner Flame. Close the distance right after dodging Thresh Q Death Sentence, but check whether Thresh W Dark Passage is down before engaging. Karma's magic damage is effective against Thresh's low magic resistance.
Thresh.laning: Keep Thresh Q Death Sentence in mind and avoid walking in a straight line. Use Karma Q Inner Flame when Thresh steps beyond the minion wall and you can hit him. If Thresh engages, hold him with Karma W Focused Resolve and use Karma E Inspire to pull your ranged carry back. Using Karma Q Inner Flame to clear minions will drain your mana, so choose your poke opportunities.
Thresh.phase: During mid-game laning, manage the mana costs of Karma Q Inner Flame and Karma E Inspire while contesting Thresh's soul collection. In the late game, focus on the teamwide shield and movement speed from Karma E Inspire empowered by Karma R Mantra rather than Karma's single-target burst.
Thresh.teamfight: If you are trapped in Thresh R The Box, choose a wall for your toughest ally to break and escape together. When Thresh W Dark Passage is thrown, finish off the target immediately or retreat. Karma should land basic abilities to get the next Karma R Mantra sooner.
Thresh.watch: Getting hit by Thresh Q Death Sentence makes you vulnerable to the follow-up crowd control, so sidestep when you see him raise his hook, and change direction again when moving up to last-hit. Avoid the line between Thresh and his allies so Thresh E Flay does not pull you toward their team.
Thresh.escape: The moment after dodging Thresh Q Death Sentence is a chance to close the distance, but don't rush in if Thresh W Dark Passage is still available. Hold him with Karma W Focused Resolve and Karma R Mantra before Thresh W Dark Passage comes back up. When engaging, avoid positions where Thresh E Flay can pull you toward allied units.

TwistedFate.build: Start with Null-Magic Mantle to survive the lane, then buy Mercury's Treads. Most of Twisted Fate's damage is magic, and Karma has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. If the yellow card is catching your carry, get Mikael's Blessing sooner.
TwistedFate.combo: When Twisted Fate does not have the yellow card, slow him with Karma Q Inner Flame, then keep Karma W Focused Resolve tethered to root him. If it is hard to get close, cast Karma E Inspire on yourself for the movement speed and get in range for Karma W Focused Resolve. Layer Karma Q Inner Flame empowered by Karma R Mantra on the rooted target, and use Karma E Inspire to help your allies engage.
TwistedFate.escape: If Twisted Fate has just used the yellow card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card, slow him with Karma Q Inner Flame, then keep Karma W Focused Resolve tethered to root him.
TwistedFate.fight: Keep your distance while Twisted Fate has the yellow card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card ready. Approach when he has a blue or red card, or right after he uses a card. As soon as he steps beyond the minion wall, hit him with Karma Q Inner Flame to slow him, maintain distance with Karma E Inspire's movement speed, and look for a root with Karma W Focused Resolve.
TwistedFate.laning: Stand behind minions to reduce poke damage from Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards. Use Karma Q Inner Flame when you have a clear angle to hit the enemy, and don't waste it on minions or you will run out of mana.
TwistedFate.phase: In the mid game, watch for Twisted Fate R Destiny roams and alert your allies when he disappears or moves to push the lane quickly. In the late game, focus on the teamwide shield and movement speed from Karma E Inspire empowered by Karma R Mantra rather than single-target damage.
TwistedFate.teamfight: If Twisted Fate's yellow card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card could catch your carry, help them retreat with Karma E Inspire and use Mikael's Blessing to counter the crowd control if needed. If Twisted Fate R Destiny appears within range, keep Karma W Focused Resolve tethered so you can interrupt his movement with a root. Use your first Karma R Mantra on the empowered ability you need, then keep landing basic abilities to get your next R Mantra sooner.
TwistedFate.watch: If Twisted Fate has locked in the yellow card with Twisted Fate W Pick a Card, one basic attack will stun you, so stay outside his attack range.

Veigar.build: Veigar's main damage is magic, so start with Null-Magic Mantle to survive and buy Mercury's Treads. If Veigar E Event Horizon catches your carry, get Mikael's Blessing sooner. Karma E Inspire's shield can block damage, but it does not remove the stun.
Veigar.combo: Slow Veigar with Karma Q Inner Flame, then hold him with Karma W Focused Resolve and keep the tether active. Layer Karma Q Inner Flame empowered by Karma R Mantra on the rooted target to also deal area damage. If your allies are engaging with you, add movement speed with Karma E Inspire. If it is hard to get close, cast it on yourself first and get in range for Karma W Focused Resolve.
Veigar.escape: After Veigar E Event Horizon is down is your chance to close the distance. Veigar has no skill to create distance on his own, so use Karma E Inspire for movement speed to approach, then keep Karma W Focused Resolve tethered to root him.
Veigar.fight: Pressure Veigar aggressively early, when he has few stacks and no mobility. When he steps beyond the minions, hit him with Karma Q Inner Flame to slow him, and close in when you can keep Karma W Focused Resolve tethered. Keep moving during trades to dodge Veigar W Dark Matter.
Veigar.laning: Veigar Q Baleful Strike passes through only the first two units it hits, so avoid the poke from behind minions. When Veigar steps beyond the minion wall, pressure him with Karma Q Inner Flame to trigger Karma P Gathering Fire and cycle Karma R Mantra. Use Karma Q Inner Flame when you have a clear angle to hit an enemy champion; don't waste it on minions.
Veigar.phase: In the mid game, keep disrupting Veigar's farming and poking to slow his growth, but don't waste mana by using Karma Q Inner Flame without purpose. Veigar's stacks make the matchup harder as the game goes on, so Karma should focus on teamwide shields and movement speed support.
Veigar.teamfight: Before starting an objective fight or teamfight, check Veigar's position and whether he has used Veigar E Event Horizon. To interrupt Veigar's engage, use Karma W Focused Resolve empowered by Karma R Mantra; to protect allies from area damage, use Karma E Inspire empowered by Karma R Mantra. Then hit enemy champions with basic abilities to trigger Karma P Gathering Fire and get the next Karma R Mantra sooner.
Veigar.watch: Veigar W Dark Matter deals heavy damage, but its landing spot and timing are visible, so watch the ground marker and sidestep. If you are caught inside Veigar E Event Horizon, move within the perimeter without crossing it and wait for it to disappear. If your health drops below half, get out of range of Veigar R Primordial Burst, which deals more damage based on your missing health.

Velkoz.build: Start with Null-Magic Mantle to survive the lane, then buy Mercury's Treads. Vel'Koz's main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first, but resistance cannot block the true damage from Vel'Koz P Organic Deconstruction or Vel'Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray.
Velkoz.combo: When Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption is down, slow him with Karma Q Inner Flame and keep Karma W Focused Resolve tethered to root him. Add movement speed with Karma E Inspire as your allies engage, and layer Karma Q Inner Flame empowered by Karma R Mantra on Vel'Koz where he is held.
Velkoz.escape: Engage as soon as Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption, his only reliable crowd control, is down. Vel'Koz has no mobility, so close in with Karma E Inspire and keep Karma W Focused Resolve tethered, but remember that Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption can knock you back if you get very close.
Velkoz.fight: Dodge or bait out Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption, then close the distance with Karma E Inspire's movement speed. Slow him with Karma Q Inner Flame and keep Karma W Focused Resolve tethered to root him, which can catch Vel'Koz, who has no mobility.
Velkoz.laning: Karma Q Inner Flame is blocked by minions, so poke when Vel'Koz steps beyond the minion wall. Use Karma E Inspire just before Vel'Koz's abilities hit or just before an ally retreats so you can benefit from both the shield and movement speed. Using Q and E carelessly will drain your mana, so choose your opportunities to land them.
Velkoz.phase: In the mid game, avoid being hit by Vel'Koz's abilities in succession while poking to trigger Karma P Gathering Fire and ready Karma R Mantra again. In the late game, support your allies with the teamwide shield and movement speed from Karma E Inspire empowered by Karma R Mantra rather than single-target burst.
Velkoz.teamfight: When Vel'Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray begins, prioritize interrupting it with Karma W Focused Resolve's root. Then hit enemy champions with basic abilities to trigger Karma P Gathering Fire and get the next R Mantra sooner.
Velkoz.watch: Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission slows even with its split beams, so don't only sidestep; move toward Vel'Koz or behind where the beam passed. If you are knocked up by Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption and then hit by consecutive abilities, Vel'Koz P Organic Deconstruction can trigger true damage. If stacks are applied to you, retreat and wait them out.

Vex.build: Start with Null-Magic Mantle, then buy Mercury's Treads. Most of Vex's damage is magic, so Karma should build magic resistance first.
Vex.combo: Slow Vex with Karma Q Inner Flame, then hold her with Karma W Focused Resolve and keep the tether active. Once she is rooted, layer Karma Q Inner Flame empowered by Karma R Mantra to also deal area damage. When your allies engage with you, give them a shield and movement speed with Karma E Inspire.
Vex.escape: If both Vex P Doom 'n Gloom's Doom and Vex W Personal Space are down, slow her with Karma Q Inner Flame, then root her with Karma W Focused Resolve.
Vex.fight: Hit Vex with Karma Q Inner Flame to slow her, and trade when you can keep Karma W Focused Resolve tethered. Your chance to catch her comes after both Vex W Personal Space's shield and Vex P Doom 'n Gloom's Doom are down. Land abilities to trigger Karma P Gathering Fire and get Karma R Mantra sooner.
Vex.laning: Karma Q Inner Flame is blocked by minions, so use it when Vex steps beyond the minion wall. To avoid running out of mana, use Karma Q Inner Flame when you have a clear angle to hit Vex, and cast Karma E Inspire ahead of time when retreating from Vex's attacks.
Vex.phase: In the mid game, use the window after Vex R Shadow Surge is down as an opportunity to engage. In the late game, Karma should help her allies with the teamwide shield and movement speed from Karma E Inspire empowered by Karma R Mantra rather than single-target burst.
Vex.teamfight: Move low-health allies out of Vex's range first so she cannot trigger a chain of damage with the first takedown from Vex R Shadow Surge. Then land basic abilities to trigger Karma P Gathering Fire and get the next Karma R Mantra sooner.
Vex.watch: When Vex P Doom 'n Gloom's Doom is ready, her basic abilities fear you, so approach after she uses it on minions or to poke. Vex E Looming Darkness gets larger the farther it travels, so if you are already in range, dodge it with a short sidestep. If Vex R Shadow Surge hits you and marks you, move toward your allies immediately.

Viktor.build: Start with Null-Magic Mantle, then buy Mercury's Treads. Viktor's main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first.
Viktor.combo: Slow Viktor with Karma Q Inner Flame, then hold him with Karma W Focused Resolve to root him, and give your allies movement speed with Karma E Inspire as they engage. If it is hard to get close, cast Karma E Inspire on yourself first to get in range for Karma W Focused Resolve.
Viktor.escape: Your chance to engage comes when Viktor has used Viktor W Gravity Field or after you leave its area. Viktor has no dash, so close the distance with Karma E Inspire and keep Karma W Focused Resolve tethered to hold him.
Viktor.fight: When Viktor steps beyond the minion wall, hit him with Karma Q Inner Flame to slow him and take a short trade. Close in from outside Viktor W Gravity Field, using Karma E Inspire's movement speed to approach and keep Karma W Focused Resolve tethered. Use landed abilities to trigger Karma P Gathering Fire and cycle Karma R Mantra.
Viktor.laning: Poke aggressively early, before Viktor P Glorious Evolution stacks up. Use Karma Q Inner Flame when you have a clear angle to hit Viktor, and don't waste mana using it on minions. If the glow color of Viktor's staff changes, he has gained an augment, so reassess the trade.
Viktor.phase: In the mid game, check Viktor's augment status and reassess the trade. Viktor grows stronger as the game goes on, so Karma should focus on teamwide shields and movement speed support rather than single-target damage.
Viktor.teamfight: When Viktor E Hextech Ray and Viktor R Arcane Storm deal area damage, protect nearby allies with Karma E Inspire empowered by Karma R Mantra. If you can reach Viktor without staying in Viktor W Gravity Field, hold him with Karma W Focused Resolve. Then keep landing basic abilities to trigger Karma P Gathering Fire and get the next Karma R Mantra sooner.
Viktor.watch: To dodge Viktor E Hextech Ray, don't stand in line with the minion wave; move to the side. When Viktor W Gravity Field is placed, use Karma E Inspire's movement speed to leave immediately, and don't stay in Viktor R Arcane Storm's area damage either.

Vladimir.build: Start with Null-Magic Mantle to survive the lane, then buy Mercury's Treads. Most of Vladimir's damage is magic, and Karma has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. If his healing is a problem, reduce it with Morellonomicon and apply it to multiple enemies with Karma Q Inner Flame.
Vladimir.combo: Use Karma Q Inner Flame to bait out Vladimir W Sanguine Pool first. When the pool ends, slow him with Karma Q Inner Flame and keep Karma W Focused Resolve tethered to root him.
Vladimir.escape: The moment after Vladimir W Sanguine Pool ends is your chance to catch him. Vladimir's movement speed is also reduced while charging Vladimir E Tides of Blood, so close the distance if you are positioned to dodge the ability. Use Karma E Inspire for movement speed to get in range for Karma W Focused Resolve.
Vladimir.fight: Bait out Vladimir W Sanguine Pool first, then close in as it ends using the slow from Karma Q Inner Flame or the movement speed from Karma E Inspire. Keep Karma W Focused Resolve tethered to root him and continue dealing damage.
Vladimir.laning: Pressure the lane and create gank opportunities while Vladimir is weak early. Karma Q Inner Flame is blocked by minions, so hit him when he steps beyond them. Using Karma Q Inner Flame and Karma E Inspire carelessly will drain your mana, so use Q when you have a clear angle to hit a champion.
Vladimir.phase: Vladimir becomes harder to deal with as he builds health and ability power over time. In the late game, Karma should focus on the teamwide shield and movement speed from Karma E Inspire empowered by Karma R Mantra rather than single-target damage.

When your allies are about to take area damage, shield them with Karma E Inspire empowered by Karma R Mantra. After Vladimir W Sanguine Pool ends, hold him with Karma W Focused Resolve and land basic abilities to get your next Karma R Mantra sooner.
Vladimir.watch: When Vladimir E Tides of Blood is charged, put minions between you and him or get out of range. Vladimir W Sanguine Pool can dodge key abilities, so use Karma W Focused Resolve after the pool ends. If hit by Vladimir R Hemoplague, retreat until the effect ends because you will take increased damage, and avoid grouping with allies.

Xerath.build: Early on, buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Xerath’s main damage is magic, and Karma has relatively low magic resistance, so prioritize magic resistance. If an ally carry is caught by Xerath E Shocking Orb’s stun, get Mikael’s Blessing sooner.
Xerath.combo: Slow with Karma Q Inner Flame, then keep Karma W Focused Resolve tethered to root him. If it’s hard to get close, cast Karma E Inspire on yourself for movement speed, then use Karma W Focused Resolve. Layer Karma Q Inner Flame empowered by Karma R Mantra on the rooted target, and help your allies engage with Karma E Inspire.

Xerath.fight: When Xerath charges Xerath Q Arcanopulse, dodge to the side while closing the gap. Once Xerath E Shocking Orb and Xerath W Eye of Destruction are down, use Karma E Inspire’s movement speed to get close and keep Karma W Focused Resolve tethered. When poking, look for an angle where Karma Q Inner Flame hits the champion, to also reduce Karma R Mantra’s cooldown.
Xerath.laning: Farm while avoiding the big hits rather than trying to dodge all of Xerath’s poke. When Xerath starts running low on mana, push the wave and call your jungler. Don’t waste Karma Q Inner Flame on clearing minions; use it when Xerath steps outside the minion line and you can hit him.
Xerath.phase: In the mid game, look for a window when Xerath is low on mana to push the wave and move with your jungler. In the late game, focus more on area shields and movement speed support than Karma’s single-target burst.

When area damage comes in, protect nearby allies too with Karma E Inspire empowered by Karma R Mantra. If you need to interrupt an engage, use empowered Karma W Focused Resolve. Then hit enemy champions with basic abilities to trigger Karma P Gathering Fire and bring Karma R Mantra up sooner.
Xerath.watch: If Xerath E Shocking Orb stuns you, you can take the full follow-up magic damage, so watch out most for that shot. Xerath Q Arcanopulse pierces minions, so when you see him charging, dodge well to the side. When you see Xerath R Rite of the Arcane’s cast animation, get ready to dodge immediately.

Yasuo.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest and Yasuo R Last Breath. Armor does not block the magic damage from Yasuo E Sweeping Blade.
Yasuo.combo: After removing Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield, slow him with Karma Q Inner Flame and keep Karma W Focused Resolve connected to root him. If Yasuo gets close and you’re in danger, empower Karma W Focused Resolve with Karma R Mantra to heal, then get away with Karma E Inspire’s shield and movement speed.

Yasuo.fight: First remove Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield with light poke, then trade. Right after Yasuo throws his whirlwind and his stacks reset, look for a chance to slow him with Karma Q Inner Flame and follow with Karma W Focused Resolve to root him.
Yasuo.laning: Manage the wave so it stays thin and pushed slightly toward your side, reducing the minions Yasuo E Sweeping Blade can use as stepping stones. Use Karma Q Inner Flame when Yasuo steps out from behind minions and you have an angle to hit him. Use Karma E Inspire in advance when you need to create distance.
Yasuo.phase: In the mid game, keep enough distance to prevent Yasuo from approaching. In the late game, help allies with Karma E Inspire and empowered shields rather than single-target burst.
Yasuo.teamfight: If Yasuo engages and catches an ally, bind him with Karma W Focused Resolve and help your ally get away with Karma E Inspire. If you need to interrupt an engage, empower W with Karma R Mantra; if you need to block area damage, empower E.
Yasuo.watch: Yasuo Q Steel Tempest has a narrow hitbox, so when Yasuo approaches, move off the line and dodge to the side. If he hits Q twice in a row and prepares his whirlwind, be ready for the knock-up, and watch for Yasuo E Sweeping Blade dashes using minions as stepping stones.

After he engages with Yone E Soul Unbound, the return can deal extra damage, so if your health is low, use the healing from Karma W Focused Resolve empowered by Karma R Mantra in advance or back off.

Zed.build: Build armor early against the physical damage from Zed Q Razor Shuriken, Zed E Shadow Slash, and Zed R Death Mark. Zed P Contempt for the Weak deals magic damage based on your max health, so avoid choices that only add a lot of health.
Zed.combo: When engaging, cast Karma E Inspire on yourself for movement speed, then close in on Zed and use Karma W Focused Resolve to look for a root. Once he’s rooted, layer Karma Q Inner Flame empowered by Karma R Mantra on him there to hit with the ground effect too. If you’re caught by Zed R Death Mark, heal with Karma W Focused Resolve empowered by Karma R Mantra and interrupt Zed’s combo.
Zed.escape: The window to engage is after Zed W Living Shadow’s shadow disappears or Zed has already changed position. If Zed R Death Mark hasn’t come back up yet, catch him with Karma W Focused Resolve so he can’t escape. If only one mobility ability is down, he can escape with another, so don’t rush your engage.
Zed.fight: Try to trade after Zed W Living Shadow’s shadow disappears or after Zed has already changed position. Poke when you have an angle for Karma Q Inner Flame to hit; it deals magic damage and can also reduce Karma R Mantra’s cooldown with Karma P Gathering Fire.
Zed.laning: Poke when you see an angle to hit Zed with Karma Q Inner Flame, and save mana when minions will block it. If Zed engages, cast Karma E Inspire before taking damage to create distance with its shield and movement speed, and catch him with Karma W Focused Resolve when you can keep the tether connected.
Zed.phase: Zed is strongest in the mid game, so don’t give him an early lead and reduce the chances of getting caught alone. In the late game, Karma should focus on shields and movement speed support over single-target burst, while allies group up to deny Zed an assassination target.
Zed.teamfight: If Zed engages on an ally with Zed R Death Mark, catch him with Karma W Focused Resolve to interrupt the combo that builds damage before the mark detonates. When area damage comes in, use Karma E Inspire empowered by Karma R Mantra on nearby allies to provide a shield and movement speed. Then hit enemy champions with basic abilities to trigger Karma P Gathering Fire and bring Karma R Mantra up sooner.
Zed.watch: Watch the position of Zed W Living Shadow and move outside the range of Zed E Shadow Slash from that shadow to avoid the slow. When Zed engages with Zed R Death Mark, he’ll try to build up damage before the mark detonates, so bind him with Karma W Focused Resolve during that time to interrupt the combo.

Zilean.escape: The window to close the gap is after Zilean E Time Warp and the bomb combo are down. Zilean has no mobility ability, so use Karma E Inspire to approach and keep Karma W Focused Resolve tethered.
Zilean.fight: When Zilean steps out from behind minions, slow him with Karma Q Inner Flame, and close in when you can keep Karma W Focused Resolve tethered.

When the enemy’s area damage comes in, protect allies with Karma E Inspire empowered by Karma R Mantra. Don’t dump abilities into a target affected by Zilean R Chronoshift while they’re reviving. If it’s hard to kill the protected damage dealer, switch your target to the squishy Zilean himself.

If it’s hard to get close, cast Karma E Inspire on yourself for movement speed, then get into W range. Layer Karma Q empowered by Karma R Mantra on the rooted target to hit her with the ground effect too.

Zoe.laning: Karma Q Inner Flame is blocked by minions, so use it when Zoe steps out from behind them, and don’t waste mana on pointless minion clearing. When you need to dodge Zoe’s bubble, use Karma E Inspire’s shield and movement speed just before you move out of its way.
Zoe.phase: The provided material isn’t enough to determine which side is stronger in the mid game, so look for a window when Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble and Zoe R Portal Jump are down. In the late game, focus more on the area shield and movement speed support from Karma E Inspire empowered by Karma R Mantra than on Karma’s single-target damage.

If the bubble hits, use the grace period to move behind a wall or ally and get out of Zoe’s Q angle. Even a missed bubble remains as a trap, so be careful in narrow paths without vision.

Use Karma E Inspire for movement speed to approach and keep Karma W Focused Resolve tethered to root her. While Zyra E Grasping Roots is still available, manage your distance first.

Step on seeds along your path to destroy them, but if Zyra uses an ability, back away and step on them again afterward. If an ally is caught, catch the champion who engaged with Karma W Focused Resolve and get your ally out with Karma E Inspire.

When you see Zyra R Stranglethorns’ summon indicator, use Karma E Inspire’s movement speed to get out of its area. Don’t fight where the plants are clustered.
